### Task A2: the vector format and its Go test

**Files:** create `internal/ecalc/pinouts_vectors_test.go`. No production code: the check lives in the test file, as for the table vectors.

The format is documented in the comment at the top of the file (it is the contract of section 6). Research agents write `testdata/vectors/pinouts/<id>.json`; Z copies them in. With no real items the real-catalog test passes trivially (the directory does not exist), and `TestPinoutVectorChecksCanFail` proves with fixtures that every rule fails when it should: an item without a file, an orphan file, a wrong `pinout` id, an unknown field, broken JSON, `counts` that do not match (so their sum is not the pin count), an unknown type in `counts`, too few spot checks, a missing pin, a wrong name, a wrong type, a missing `ref`, a pin checked twice, a duplicated or missing variant entry, and the item entry for an item with variants.

- [ ] **Step 1: create the test file.** The test only calls code that exists after A1, so there is no separate red step beyond its own fixtures: write the file, then run it; the `CanFail` test is the red proof (every case must report its problem).

`internal/ecalc/pinouts_vectors_test.go`:
```go
package ecalc

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"testing/fstest"
)

// testdata/vectors/pinouts/<pinout id>.json is the independent check of one pinout item: the pin types as counted from
// the source, and spot checks of pins against the standard or the datasheet.
//
//	{"pinout": "usb_a", "variants": [{"variant": "", "counts": {"power": 1, "ground": 1, "data": 2}, "pins": [
//	  {"number": "1", "name": "VBUS", "type": "power", "ref": "USB 2.0 specification, table 6-1"}, ...]}]}
//
// There is one entry per variant ("variant": "" for an item without variants). counts holds the number of pins of every
// type (a type without pins may be left out); the sum is the pin count of the item. pins holds at least three spot checks
// per variant (all pins when there are fewer), each with the source in ref. A vector file without an item and an item
// without a vector file both fail.
type pinoutVectorPin struct {
	Number string `json:"number"`
	Name   string `json:"name"`
	Type   string `json:"type"`
	Ref    string `json:"ref"`
}

type pinoutVectorVariant struct {
	Variant string            `json:"variant"`
	Counts  map[string]int    `json:"counts"`
	Pins    []pinoutVectorPin `json:"pins"`
}

type pinoutVectors struct {
	Pinout   string                `json:"pinout"`
	Variants []pinoutVectorVariant `json:"variants"`
}

// minSpotChecks is the number of pins that a vector checks per variant, or all of them when there are fewer.
const minSpotChecks = 3

// checkPinoutVectors compares the vector files of vecs (a directory of <id>.json files) with the pinouts of the catalog and
// returns every problem found.
func checkPinoutVectors(cat *Catalog, vecs fs.FS) []string {
	var problems []string
	add := func(format string, args ...any) { problems = append(problems, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)) }

	entries, err := fs.ReadDir(vecs, ".")
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
		return []string{err.Error()}
	}
	files := map[string]bool{}
	for _, e := range entries {
		if e.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), ".json") {
			continue
		}
		id := strings.TrimSuffix(e.Name(), ".json")
		files[id] = true
		p := cat.Pinout(id)
		if p == nil {
			add("%s: there is no pinout %q (an orphan vector file)", e.Name(), id)
			continue
		}
		data, err := fs.ReadFile(vecs, e.Name())
		if err != nil {
			add("%s: %v", e.Name(), err)
			continue
		}
		var v pinoutVectors
		dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
		dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
		if err := dec.Decode(&v); err != nil {
			add("%s: %v", e.Name(), err)
			continue
		}
		for _, msg := range checkPinoutVector(p, v) {
			add("%s: %s", e.Name(), msg)
		}
	}
	for _, p := range cat.Pinouts {
		if !files[p.ID] {
			add("pinout %s has no vector file %s.json", p.ID, p.ID)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(problems)
	return problems
}

// checkPinoutVector checks one vector file against its pinout.
func checkPinoutVector(p *Pinout, v pinoutVectors) []string {
	var problems []string
	add := func(format string, args ...any) { problems = append(problems, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)) }
	if v.Pinout != p.ID {
		add("pinout is %q, want %q", v.Pinout, p.ID)
	}
	want := []string{""}
	if len(p.Variants) > 0 {
		want = nil
		for _, variant := range p.Variants {
			want = append(want, variant.ID)
		}
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, ve := range v.Variants {
		label := "variant " + ve.Variant
		if ve.Variant == "" {
			label = "the item"
		}
		if seen[ve.Variant] {
			add("%s appears twice", label)
			continue
		}
		seen[ve.Variant] = true
		pins, _, ok := p.PinsOf(ve.Variant)
		if !ok || (ve.Variant == "" && len(p.Variants) > 0) {
			add("%s: the pinout has no such variant (variants: %s)", label, strings.Join(want, ", "))
			continue
		}
		byNumber := map[string]Pin{}
		actual := map[string]int{}
		for _, pin := range pins {
			byNumber[pin.Number] = pin
			actual[pin.Type]++
		}
		for typ, n := range ve.Counts {
			if !contains(PinTypes, typ) {
				add("%s: counts has the unknown type %q", label, typ)
			} else if n < 0 {
				add("%s: counts %s is negative", label, typ)
			}
		}
		for _, typ := range PinTypes {
			if ve.Counts[typ] != actual[typ] {
				add("%s: counts %s = %d, but the pinout has %d", label, typ, ve.Counts[typ], actual[typ])
			}
		}
		if need := min(minSpotChecks, len(pins)); len(ve.Pins) < need {
			add("%s: %d spot checks, want at least %d", label, len(ve.Pins), need)
		}
		checked := map[string]bool{}
		for _, sp := range ve.Pins {
			pin, found := byNumber[sp.Number]
			switch {
			case checked[sp.Number]:
				add("%s: pin %q is checked twice", label, sp.Number)
			case !found:
				add("%s: the pinout has no pin %q", label, sp.Number)
			case pin.Name != sp.Name:
				add("%s: pin %s is named %q, the vector says %q", label, sp.Number, pin.Name, sp.Name)
			case pin.Type != sp.Type:
				add("%s: pin %s has the type %q, the vector says %q", label, sp.Number, pin.Type, sp.Type)
			}
			checked[sp.Number] = true
			if strings.TrimSpace(sp.Ref) == "" {
				add("%s: pin %s has no ref (the source of the check)", label, sp.Number)
			}
		}
	}
	for _, id := range want {
		if !seen[id] {
			if id == "" {
				add("the vector has no entry for the item (variant \"\")")
			} else {
				add("the vector has no entry for variant %s", id)
			}
		}
	}
	return problems
}

// The real vectors: every pinout has a file and every file a pinout. Without items the check passes trivially.
func TestPinoutVectors(t *testing.T) {
	cat, err := Default()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if problems := checkPinoutVectors(cat, os.DirFS("testdata/vectors/pinouts")); len(problems) > 0 {
		t.Errorf("the pinout vectors disagree with the catalog:\n%s", strings.Join(problems, "\n"))
	}
}

const goodVector = `{"pinout": "t_conn", "variants": [{"variant": "", "counts": {"power": 1, "ground": 1, "data": 1}, "pins": [
  {"number": "1", "name": "VCC", "type": "power", "ref": "Datasheet table 1"},
  {"number": "2", "name": "GND", "type": "ground", "ref": "Datasheet table 1"},
  {"number": "3", "name": "TX", "type": "data", "ref": "Datasheet table 1"}]}]}`

// A fixture proves that the check can fail: every rule has a vector that it refuses.
func TestPinoutVectorChecksCanFail(t *testing.T) {
	three := pinLine("1", "A", "power", "") + pinLine("2", "B", "ground", "") + pinLine("3", "C", "data", "")
	cat := loadPinouts(t, basePinout+strings.Replace(variantsOf(three, three), "t_conn", "t_var", 1))
	good := fstest.MapFS{"t_conn.json": {Data: []byte(goodVector)}, "t_var.json": {Data: []byte(goodVariantVector)}}
	if problems := checkPinoutVectors(cat, good); len(problems) > 0 {
		t.Fatalf("the good vectors fail: %v", problems)
	}

	with := func(name, data string) fstest.MapFS {
		fsys := fstest.MapFS{"t_conn.json": {Data: []byte(goodVector)}, "t_var.json": {Data: []byte(goodVariantVector)}}
		if data == "" {
			delete(fsys, name)
		} else {
			fsys[name] = &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte(data)}
		}
		return fsys
	}
	cases := []struct {
		name string
		fsys fstest.MapFS
		want string
	}{
		{"an item without a file", with("t_conn.json", ""), "pinout t_conn has no vector file t_conn.json"},
		{"an orphan file", with("ghost.json", goodVector), `there is no pinout "ghost"`},
		{"another pinout id inside", with("t_conn.json", strings.Replace(goodVector, `"pinout": "t_conn"`, `"pinout": "x"`, 1)), `pinout is "x", want "t_conn"`},
		{"an unknown field", with("t_conn.json", strings.Replace(goodVector, `"pinout"`, `"colour": 1, "pinout"`, 1)), `unknown field "colour"`},
		{"broken json", with("t_conn.json", `{`), "unexpected EOF"},
		{"counts that do not match", with("t_conn.json", strings.Replace(goodVector, `"power": 1`, `"power": 2`, 1)), "counts power = 2, but the pinout has 1"},
		{"counts without a type", with("t_conn.json", strings.Replace(goodVector, `"data": 1`, `"signal": 0`, 1)), "counts data = 0, but the pinout has 1"},
		{"counts with an unknown type", with("t_conn.json", strings.Replace(goodVector, `"data": 1`, `"data": 1, "bus": 1`, 1)), `unknown type "bus"`},
		{"too few spot checks", with("t_conn.json", strings.Replace(goodVector, `,
  {"number": "3", "name": "TX", "type": "data", "ref": "Datasheet table 1"}`, "", 1)), "2 spot checks, want at least 3"},
		{"a spot check of a missing pin", with("t_conn.json", strings.Replace(goodVector, `"number": "3"`, `"number": "9"`, 1)), `the pinout has no pin "9"`},
		{"a spot check with the wrong name", with("t_conn.json", strings.Replace(goodVector, `"name": "TX"`, `"name": "RX"`, 1)), `pin 3 is named "TX", the vector says "RX"`},
		{"a spot check with the wrong type", with("t_conn.json", strings.Replace(goodVector, `"type": "data"`, `"type": "signal"`, 1)), `pin 3 has the type "data", the vector says "signal"`},
		{"a spot check without ref", with("t_conn.json", strings.Replace(goodVector, `"ref": "Datasheet table 1"}]`, `"ref": ""}]`, 1)), "pin 3 has no ref"},
		{"a pin checked twice", with("t_conn.json", strings.Replace(goodVector, `"number": "2"`, `"number": "1"`, 1)), `pin "1" is checked twice`},
		{"a variant entry missing", with("t_var.json", strings.Replace(goodVariantVector, `{"variant": "bb"`, `{"variant": "aa"`, 1)), "variant aa appears twice"},
		{"the item entry for a variants item", with("t_var.json", strings.ReplaceAll(goodVariantVector, `"variant": "aa"`, `"variant": ""`)), "the pinout has no such variant (variants: aa, bb)"},
		{"no entry for a variant", with("t_var.json", onlyVariantAA), "no entry for variant bb"},
		{"no entry for the item", with("t_conn.json", `{"pinout": "t_conn", "variants": []}`), `no entry for the item`},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		problems := strings.Join(checkPinoutVectors(cat, c.fsys), "\n")
		if !strings.Contains(problems, c.want) {
			t.Errorf("%s: problems = %q, want it to contain %q", c.name, problems, c.want)
		}
	}
}

const goodVariantVector = `{"pinout": "t_var", "variants": [
 {"variant": "aa", "counts": {"power": 1, "ground": 1, "data": 1}, "pins": [
  {"number": "1", "name": "A", "type": "power", "ref": "R"}, {"number": "2", "name": "B", "type": "ground", "ref": "R"}, {"number": "3", "name": "C", "type": "data", "ref": "R"}]},
 {"variant": "bb", "counts": {"power": 1, "ground": 1, "data": 1}, "pins": [
```

## Part UP — The connector renderer and the pinout page (tasks UP1–UP3)


**Goal:** The ECalc app shows the item kind `pinout` (contract sections 2, 3, 4, 7, 10): a DOM-free renderer (`ECalcPinoutDraw`) that draws every shape type and every one of the sixteen outlines of `rows` as its own recognisable connector, a page (`ECalcPinoutPage`) with variant selector, view toggle, drawing, legend, detail panel, linked pin table, filter and copy, the shell routing with the six sections of the Pinouts list, the 24 strings in 16 locales, the stylesheet section, and the tests (node geometry test, static tests, four browser tests with fixture pinouts, one skin test). No real pinout item is added: Part Z does that, and the browser test opens every real pinout of the catalog (zero today).

**Architecture:** `ecalc-pinout-draw.js` computes a *layout* (plain data: contacts, shell paths, names, leaders, wire stubs, numbers) and turns it into SVG markup. The mirror image of the other view is made on the layout: every x of a contact, number, name, leader and stub becomes `width - x`, the names swap their side, and only the shell group (paths, no text) carries `translate(W 0) scale(-1 1)`, so no text is ever flipped. A number is written inside its contact when its estimated width fits (`fitNumber`: 11, 10 or 9 units), else it moves out (above the first row, below the last row); the real browser run confirms the rule. `ecalc-pinout-page.js` is a page creator like the table and code pages. The shared fixture `scripts/ecalc-pinout-fixtures.js` is evaluated by the node test and injected into the served catalog by the browser tests.

**Tech stack:** classic scripts, SVG strings, tokens-only CSS, Go tests with rod, a node vm test. `GOTMPDIR` = `C:\tmp\go-build-ecalc-p4-up`.

**Base:** the ECalc phase 3 state plus Part A (uncommitted in the drafting worktree; Part UP needs `catalog/pinstyles.yaml`, `pin_types`, `wires` and the pinout JSON of Part A, the snapshot `internal/ecalc/testdata/catalog.en.json` with `pin_types` and `wires`, and `ecalc.PinoutGroups`, `ecalc.PinoutOutlines`, `Catalog.Pinouts`, `Catalog.PinTypeStyles`). Files this plan creates: `ui/js/desktop/apps/ecalc/ecalc-pinout-draw.js`, `ecalc-pinout-page.js`, `scripts/ecalc-pinout-fixtures.js`, `scripts/test-ecalc-pinouts.mjs`, `ui/desktop_ecalc_pinouts_test.go`, `ui/desktop_ecalc_pinouts_browser_test.go`. Files it edits: `ui/js/desktop/apps/ecalc/ecalc-shell.js`, `ui/js/desktop/core/module-loader.js`, `ui/css/desktop-app-ecalc.css`, `ui/lang/desktop/*.json` (16), `package.json`, `ui/desktop_ecalc_test.go`, `ui/desktop_ecalc_codes_browser_test.go`, `ui/desktop_ecalc_tables_browser_test.go`.

### Contract deviations

1. **A shared fixture file** `scripts/ecalc-pinout-fixtures.js` (not in the ownership table, next to `test-ecalc-pinouts.mjs`): one function expression `() => [items]` that the node test evaluates and the Go browser tests splice into the served catalog, so both test the same 36 fixture pinouts (every outline, all six shape types, USB-C 24 contacts, HDMI 19, a 2x20 header, a 38-pin board, DIP-28, wires, variants, a single column with symbol numbers `S + -`, seven variants with long names, long texts and 8-character numbers).
2. **A static test file** `ui/desktop_ecalc_pinouts_test.go` (locale keys, wiring, DOM-free draw, page rules, stylesheet section, fixture coverage) next to the browser test file. The browser tests are **five** (`TestDesktopECalcPinoutsBrowser`, `...PinoutDrawingsBrowser`, `...PinoutCompactBrowser`, `...PinoutRealBrowser`, `...PinoutSkinsBrowser`): the page budget of the fixture is 170 s and one test for 36 fixtures in two views, a phone-sized window and the real catalog ran into it.
3. **The options object of every page creator gains `pinTypes` and `wires`** (`catalog.pin_types`, `catalog.wires`); the existing test that pins the option keys (tables browser test) lists them now. The contract left open how a page gets the type styles.
4. **Sizing of the drawing:** the svg has its natural size in CSS pixels (1 unit = 1 px) and the page sets its `width`/`height` attributes between 0.72 and 1.6 times that (a dense connector shrinks to its host, never below 0.72; below that it scrolls *inside* its own area, never the page). A small connector is enlarged up to 1.6.
5. **Orientation of the shells (binding facts from the coordinator, drawn in the `drawn` view; the other view mirrors them):** `rj45` latch notch at the bottom, `displayport` cut corner lower left, `hdmi_a`/`usb_mini_b`/`usb_micro_b` wide side up, `usb_b` chamfers on top, `usb_a` tongue in the upper half, `dsub` wide side up, `obd2` wide side up (pins 1-8 are the top row because the rows are written top to bottom). `sata_data` has its L step at the lower right, `sata_power` at the lower left, `molex` two cut lower corners, `minifit` the latch on top and small lower cuts, `jst` a locking ramp on top: Part Z/research must check these two against the rows if a source says otherwise.
6. **Wire stubs** are drawn where the type is `rows`: below a single row or the last row, above the first row of several rows, and to the *left* of a single column (a servo, Qwiic: the names stand on the right). A stub whose side holds an outside number is skipped (the table has the swatch); no current outline needs it.
7. **Existing tests edited:** `desktop_ecalc_test.go` (the key whitelist gains `ecalcPinoutKeys`, the shell marker list gains the pinout creator), `desktop_ecalc_codes_browser_test.go` (the code pages section may be followed by the pinouts section; the loader order lists the two new scripts), `desktop_ecalc_tables_browser_test.go` (option keys; the Pinouts rail entry is shown exactly when the real catalog has pinouts, instead of "never").
8. **No bundle change:** `module-loader.js` is not part of `main.bundle.js` (`node scripts/build-ui-bundles.js --check` is clean).
9. **Layout of a board with a connector on a pin edge:** the connector block is drawn inside the board (no protrusion) and behind the pads. Names of the top and bottom edge of a board are rotated 90 degrees (read bottom to top above, top to bottom below); no mirror is involved.

### What other parts must know

- `ECalcPinoutDraw.layout(shape, pins, {view})`, `svg({layout, types, wires, label})`, `OUTLINES`, `fitNumber`, `safeColor`, `textWidth`; the page options `pinTypes`/`wires`; the keys `desktop.ecalc_group_{data,audio,pc_power,boards,debug,ics}` and `desktop.ecalc_pin_*` (24 in all, listed in `ecalcPinoutKeys`).
- Pin numbers can be any text of 1 to 8 characters; they are escaped in `data-pin` and found with `CSS.escape` (symbols `+ - S` work).
- The browser tests inject their fixtures only when `window.ecalcWithReal` is not set; with it the served catalog is the real one and every real pinout must draw soundly (geometry, no overlap, no mirrored text, no sideways scroll). Part Z must run `TestDesktopECalcPinoutRealBrowser` after assembling the content; I ran it against the 34 research YAML files of data, boards, debug and ics (copied temporarily, removed again): all 34 pass after the `ICSP.2`-style inner numbers got wide pads.

### GitNexus impact (before editing)

`pageCreator`, `pageOptions`, `paintList` of `ecalc-shell.js` are closures inside `create`: `impact` answers `Target not found` / ambiguous with risk UNKNOWN. Confirmed by grep: `pageCreator` and `pageOptions` are called only in `mountPage` of the same file, `paintList` only inside `create`; `ECalcShell` is used by `ecalc.js` only. The edits are additive (one more kind, two more option keys, the section list chosen by kind). The tests that pin the shell source are updated in this plan.

```js
// Fixture pinouts of the ECalc pinout page: one function expression `() => [item, ...]` that builds pinout items in exactly the
// shape of the catalog JSON (internal/ecalc/pinouts.go, "Catalog JSON" of the contract: every shape field present). The node
// test scripts/test-ecalc-pinouts.mjs evaluates it in a vm, ui/desktop_ecalc_pinouts_browser_test.go puts the same text into
// the served catalog. The names are German like the rest of the fixture catalog. The pins are made up (no real connector).
//   Every outline of `rows` appears once (fx_pin_<outline>), plus the dense ones: usb_c (24 contacts), hdmi_a (19),
//   fx_pin_header40 (2 x 20), fx_pin_board38 (38 pins), fx_pin_dip28; the shapes circular (two), dip (two), to (to92, to220),
//   jack (TRS, TRRS with variants) and board (two, with inner headers); a single row with wires and variants (fx_pin_rj45); a
//   page with long notes and long names (fx_pin_long); an item with 8-character numbers (fx_pin_wide_numbers).
() => {
    const TYPES = ['power', 'ground', 'signal', 'data', 'io', 'nc'];
    const NAMES = ['VBUS', 'GND', 'D+', 'D-', 'CC1', 'SBU1', 'TX1+', 'RX2-', 'GPIO23', 'SDA', 'SCL', '3V3', 'RESET', 'TMDS D2+', 'HSYNC', 'NC'];
    const shape = extra => Object.assign({
        type: '', outline: '', contact: '', drawn: '', key: null, rows: [], pins: null, package: '', positions: [], segments: [],
        left: [], right: [], top: [], bottom: [], connector: '', inner: []
    }, extra);
    const pinsOf = (numbers, offset, wires) => numbers.map((number, i) => {
        const type = TYPES[(i + (offset || 0)) % TYPES.length];
        const pin = {
            number, name: NAMES[(i + (offset || 0)) % NAMES.length] + (i >= NAMES.length ? String(i) : ''), type,
            function: 'Funktion von Pin ' + number + ' (' + type + ')', notes: i % 5 === 3 ? 'Hinweis zu Pin ' + number + ': nur im Testbetrieb.' : '', wire: ''
        };
        if (wires) pin.wire = wires[i % wires.length];
        return pin;
    });
    const item = (id, group, name, sh, numbers, extra) => Object.assign({
        kind: 'pinout', id, category: 'pinouts', group, name, name_en: name + ' (en)', doc: 'Ein Testanschluss für die Zeichnung.', notes: '', tags: [id.replace(/_/g, ' '), 'fixture'],
        source: 'Fixture, kein echter Anschluss', views: null, shape: sh, pins: pinsOf(numbers, extra && extra.offset, extra && extra.wires), variants: []
    }, extra && extra.fields);
    const two = { plug: 'Stecker (Stifte), Blick auf die Steckseite', socket: 'Buchse (Kontakte), Blick auf die Steckseite' };
    const range = (from, to) => Array.from({ length: to - from + 1 }, (_, i) => String(from + i));
    const rows = (outline, contact, drawn, lists, key) => shape({ type: 'rows', outline, contact, drawn, key: key || 'none', rows: lists.map(l => (Array.isArray(l) ? { pins: l, offset: 0 } : l)) });
    const flat = lists => lists.flatMap(l => (Array.isArray(l) ? l : l.pins)).filter(n => n !== null);
    const make = (id, group, name, outline, contact, lists, extra, key) => {
        const sh = rows(outline, contact, 'plug', lists, key);
        return item(id, group, name, sh, flat(lists), Object.assign({ fields: { views: two } }, extra));
    };
    const out = [];

    // ---- one item per outline of rows ----
    out.push(make('fx_pin_rect', 'boards', 'Fixture: Pfostenstecker 2x5', 'rect', 'square', [['1', '3', '5', '7', '9'], ['2', '4', '6', '8', '10']], {}, 'top'));
    out.push(make('fx_pin_dsub', 'data', 'Fixture: Sub-D 9', 'dsub', 'round', [['1', '2', '3', '4', '5'], { pins: ['6', '7', '8', '9'], offset: 0.5 }], { offset: 3 }));
    out.push(make('fx_pin_dsub15', 'data', 'Fixture: Sub-D 15 (3 Reihen)', 'dsub', 'round', [range(1, 5), range(6, 10), range(11, 15)]));
    out.push(make('fx_pin_usb_a', 'data', 'Fixture: USB-A', 'usb_a', 'blade', [['1', '2', '3', '4']]));
    out.push(make('fx_pin_usb_a3', 'data', 'Fixture: USB-A 3.0', 'usb_a', 'blade', [['1', '2', '3', '4'], { pins: ['5', '6', '7', '8', '9'], offset: 0 }]));
    out.push(make('fx_pin_usb_b', 'data', 'Fixture: USB-B', 'usb_b', 'blade', [['1', '2'], ['3', '4']]));
    out.push(make('fx_pin_usb_mini_b', 'data', 'Fixture: USB Mini-B', 'usb_mini_b', 'blade', [['1', '2', '3', '4', '5']]));
    out.push(make('fx_pin_usb_micro_b', 'data', 'Fixture: USB Micro-B', 'usb_micro_b', 'blade', [['1', '2', '3', '4', '5']]));
    out.push(make('fx_pin_usb_c', 'data', 'Fixture: USB-C (24 Kontakte)', 'usb_c', 'blade', [['A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'A5', 'A6', 'A7', 'A8', 'A9', 'A10', 'A11', 'A12'], ['B12', 'B11', 'B10', 'B9', 'B8', 'B7', 'B6', 'B5', 'B4', 'B3', 'B2', 'B1']]));
```

`scripts/test-ecalc-pinouts.mjs`:
```js
// ECalc desktop app: geometry test of the pinout drawings. ui/js/desktop/apps/ecalc/ecalc-pinout-draw.js runs in a Node vm
// without a document; the items are the fixture pinouts of scripts/ecalc-pinout-fixtures.js (every outline of rows, every
// shape type, dense connectors) and every pinout of internal/ecalc/testdata/catalog.en.json (none until the content is
// assembled). For every item, variant and view the layout must draw every pin exactly once, on a unique position, inside
// the viewBox (the shell too); the other view of rows and circular is the mirror image about the vertical axis (x ->
// width - x, the same y, the names change their side); the markup has one g.ec-pin per contact with the hex of its type as the
// fill attribute and the ink of its type on the number inside, escapes what the data holds, and never puts a transform with
// a scale on a text. fitNumber is the rule that keeps a number inside its contact.
// Run: node scripts/test-ecalc-pinouts.mjs   (npm run test:ecalc)
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import vm from 'node:vm';

const root = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..');
const read = file => fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, file), 'utf8');
// Data made inside the vm has the prototypes of another realm: assert.deepEqual needs plain copies.
const plain = value => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));

const window = {};
const sandbox = vm.createContext({ window });
vm.runInContext(read('ui/js/desktop/apps/ecalc/ecalc-pinout-draw.js'), sandbox);
const Draw = window.ECalcPinoutDraw;
assert.ok(Draw && typeof Draw.layout === 'function' && typeof Draw.svg === 'function' && Array.isArray(Draw.OUTLINES), 'the file publishes window.ECalcPinoutDraw');
assert.equal(Draw.OUTLINES.length, 16, 'sixteen outlines');

const snapshot = JSON.parse(read('internal/ecalc/testdata/catalog.en.json'));
const fixtures = plain(vm.runInContext('(' + read('scripts/ecalc-pinout-fixtures.js') + ')', sandbox)());
assert.ok(fixtures.length >= 30, 'the fixture has its items');
const types = Object.fromEntries(snapshot.pin_types.map(type => [type.id, { hex: type.hex, ink: type.ink }]));
const wires = Object.fromEntries(snapshot.wires.map(wire => [wire.id, { hex: wire.hex, stripe: wire.stripe }]));
assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(types), ['power', 'ground', 'signal', 'data', 'io', 'nc'], 'the pin types of the snapshot');

const real = snapshot.items.filter(item => item.kind === 'pinout');
const items = fixtures.concat(real);

// Every outline of rows is drawn by some fixture, and so is every shape type.
const outlines = new Set(fixtures.filter(item => item.shape.type === 'rows').map(item => item.shape.outline));
assert.deepEqual([...outlines].sort(), [...Draw.OUTLINES].sort(), 'the fixtures draw every outline');
assert.deepEqual([...new Set(fixtures.map(item => item.shape.type))].sort(), ['board', 'circular', 'dip', 'jack', 'rows', 'to']);

const EPS = 0.51; // the layout rounds contacts to 0.01 and the width up to a whole unit
const shapeNumbers = shape => {
    const list = [];
    if (shape.type === 'rows') shape.rows.forEach(row => row.pins.forEach(n => { if (n !== null) list.push(n); }));
    else if (shape.type === 'dip') for (let i = 1; i <= shape.pins; i++) list.push(String(i));
    else if (shape.type === 'to') list.push(...shape.pins);
    else if (shape.type === 'circular') shape.positions.forEach(p => list.push(p.pin));
    else if (shape.type === 'jack') list.push(...shape.segments);
    else if (shape.type === 'board') {
        for (const side of ['left', 'right', 'top', 'bottom']) shape[side].forEach(n => { if (n !== null) list.push(n); });
        shape.inner.forEach(group => group.rows.forEach(row => row.pins.forEach(n => { if (n !== null) list.push(n); })));
    }
    return list;
};

let checked = 0;
for (const item of items) {
    const variantPins = item.variants.length ? item.variants.map(variant => variant.pins) : [item.pins];
    for (const pins of variantPins) {
        const wanted = shapeNumbers(item.shape);
        assert.deepEqual([...pins.map(pin => pin.number)].sort(), [...wanted].sort(), `${item.id}: the pins and the shape name the same numbers`);
        const two = item.shape.type === 'rows' || item.shape.type === 'circular';
        const views = two ? ['plug', 'socket'] : [item.shape.drawn];
        const layouts = views.map(view => plain(Draw.layout(item.shape, pins, { view })));
        layouts.forEach((view, index) => {
            const label = `${item.id} (${views[index]})`;
            assert.ok(view.width > 0 && view.height > 0 && Number.isInteger(view.width) && Number.isInteger(view.height), `${label}: a whole-unit size`);
            assert.deepEqual(view.contacts.map(c => c.number).sort(), [...wanted].sort(), `${label}: every pin drawn exactly once`);
            const seen = new Set();
            for (const c of view.contacts) {
                const key = c.x + ',' + c.y;
                assert.ok(!seen.has(key), `${label}: pin ${c.number} shares the position ${key}`);
                seen.add(key);
                assert.ok(c.x - c.w / 2 >= -EPS && c.x + c.w / 2 <= view.width + EPS && c.y - c.h / 2 >= -EPS && c.y + c.h / 2 <= view.height + EPS, `${label}: pin ${c.number} lies inside the viewBox`);
                assert.ok(c.num.x >= 0 && c.num.x <= view.width && c.num.y >= 0 && c.num.y <= view.height, `${label}: the number of pin ${c.number} lies inside the viewBox`);
                if (c.num.mode === 'in' && c.shape !== 'path') {
                    const fs = Draw.fitNumber(c.number, c.kind, c.w, c.h);
                    assert.ok(fs === c.num.fs || c.num.fs === 8 || c.num.fs === 9 || c.num.fs === 10, `${label}: the font size of the number of pin ${c.number}`);
                }
                if (c.label) assert.ok(c.label.x >= 0 && c.label.x <= view.width, `${label}: the name of pin ${c.number} starts inside the viewBox`);
            }
            const [x0, y0, x1, y1] = view.shellBox;
            assert.ok(x0 >= -EPS && y0 >= -EPS && x1 <= view.width + EPS && y1 <= view.height + EPS && x1 > x0 && y1 > y0, `${label}: the shell lies inside the viewBox`);
            assert.equal(view.mirrored, two && views[index] !== item.shape.drawn, `${label}: mirrored flag`);
            // The markup.
            const markup = Draw.svg({ layout: view, types, wires, label: item.name });
            assert.equal((markup.match(/<g class="ec-pin"/g) || []).length, view.contacts.length, `${label}: one g.ec-pin per contact`);
            assert.ok(markup.includes(`viewBox="0 0 ${view.width} ${view.height}"`), `${label}: viewBox`);
            assert.ok(!/<text[^>]*scale\(/.test(markup) && !/<g[^>]*scale\(-1[^>]*>\s*<text/.test(markup), `${label}: no text is scaled`);
            const shellGroup = markup.match(/<g class="ec-pin-shell"([^>]*)>/)[1];
            assert.equal(shellGroup.includes('scale(-1 1)'), view.mirrored, `${label}: only a mirrored view flips the shell group`);
            const chunks = new Map(markup.split('<g class="ec-pin" ').slice(1).map(chunk => [chunk.match(/data-pin="([^"]*)"/)[1], chunk]));
            for (const c of view.contacts) {
                const style = types[c.type] || types.nc, chunk = chunks.get(c.number.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/</g, '&lt;'));
                assert.ok(chunk, `${label}: data-pin of ${c.number}`);
                assert.ok(new RegExp(`class="ec-pin-body"[^>]*fill="${style.hex}"`).test(chunk), `${label}: the fill of pin ${c.number} is the hex of ${c.type}`);
                if (c.num.mode === 'in') assert.ok(chunk.includes(`fill="${style.ink}">`), `${label}: the number of pin ${c.number} is written in the ink of ${c.type}`);
                else assert.ok(!/class="ec-pin-num[^"]*"[^>]*fill=/.test(chunk), `${label}: a number outside its contact has no ink of its own`);
            }
            const first = view.contacts.filter(c => c.mark);
            assert.equal(first.length, 1, `${label}: exactly one marked pin`);
            assert.equal(first[0].number, view.contacts.some(c => c.number === '1') ? '1' : view.contacts[0].number, `${label}: the mark is on pin 1, or on the first pin`);
            checked++;
        });
        if (two) {
            const [a, b] = layouts;
            assert.equal(a.width, b.width);
            assert.equal(a.height, b.height);
            const byNumber = new Map(b.contacts.map(c => [c.number, c]));
            for (const c of a.contacts) {
                const m = byNumber.get(c.number);
                assert.ok(Math.abs(c.x + m.x - a.width) < 0.011, `${item.id}: pin ${c.number} is mirrored about the axis (${c.x} / ${m.x} in ${a.width})`);
                assert.equal(c.y, m.y, `${item.id}: pin ${c.number} keeps its height`);
                assert.ok(Math.abs(c.num.x + m.num.x - a.width) < 0.011, `${item.id}: the number of pin ${c.number} is mirrored`);
                assert.equal(c.num.mode, m.num.mode, `${item.id}: the number stays inside or outside`);
                if (c.label) {
                    assert.ok(m.label && m.label.anchor === (c.label.anchor === 'start' ? 'end' : c.label.anchor === 'end' ? 'start' : 'middle'), `${item.id}: the name of pin ${c.number} changes its side`);
                    assert.ok(Math.abs(c.label.x + m.label.x - a.width) < 0.011, `${item.id}: the name of pin ${c.number} is mirrored`);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
assert.ok(checked >= 60, `checked ${checked} layouts`);

// Escaping: nothing of the data reaches the markup unescaped, and a colour that is no hex falls back.
{
    const item = { shape: { type: 'jack', drawn: 'side', segments: ['"<&', 'R', 'S'], rows: [], pins: null, positions: [], left: [], right: [], top: [], bottom: [], inner: [] }, pins: [
        { number: '"<&', name: '<b>x</b>', type: 'power', wire: '' }, { number: 'R', name: 'R', type: 'bogus', wire: '' }, { number: 'S', name: 'S', type: 'ground', wire: '' }] };
    const markup = Draw.svg({ layout: Draw.layout(item.shape, item.pins, {}), types: { power: { hex: 'red;" onload="x', ink: '#ffffff' }, ground: types.ground, nc: types.nc }, wires: {}, label: '"><script>' });
    assert.ok(!markup.includes('<script>') && !markup.includes('<b>') && !markup.includes('onload'), 'the markup is escaped and the colours are checked');
    assert.ok(markup.includes('data-pin="&quot;&lt;&amp;"'), 'data-pin is escaped');
    assert.ok(markup.includes(`fill="${types.nc.hex}"`), 'an unknown type and a bad colour fall back to the nc colour');
}
// Symbols as pin numbers (a servo header: S + -) are safe data-pin values and fit their contact.
{
    const shape = { type: 'rows', outline: 'jst', contact: 'blade', drawn: 'plug', key: 'none', rows: [{ pins: ['S'], offset: 0 }, { pins: ['+'], offset: 0 }, { pins: ['-'], offset: 0 }], pins: null, positions: [], segments: [], left: [], right: [], top: [], bottom: [], inner: [] };
    const pins = ['S', '+', '-'].map(number => ({ number, name: 'N' + number, type: 'signal', wire: '' }));
    const layout = plain(Draw.layout(shape, pins, { view: 'plug' }));
    assert.deepEqual(layout.contacts.map(c => c.number), ['S', '+', '-']);
    assert.ok(layout.contacts.every(c => c.label && c.name), 'a single column carries its names');
}
// The rule for the numbers: they fit inside or move out.
assert.ok(Draw.fitNumber('12', 'round', 20, 20) > 0, 'two digits fit a round contact of 20');
assert.equal(Draw.fitNumber('A12', 'blade', 13, 16), 0, 'a three-character number does not fit a blade');
assert.equal(Draw.fitNumber('10', 'blade', 12, 16), 0, 'two digits do not fit a thin blade');
console.log(`ecalc pinouts: ${items.length} items (${fixtures.length} fixtures, ${real.length} of the catalog), ${checked} layouts checked`);
```

```js
/* ECalc pinout drawings: the connector, the board header or the IC package that a pinout page shows. A DOM-free classic script
   that publishes window.ECalcPinoutDraw and builds inline SVG strings, like ecalc-code-draw.js does. The fill of a contact is

   attributes: a power pin stays red in every desktop skin); the shells, the leaders, the names and the outside numbers take
   currentColor and the classes ec-pin-* and ec-shell-* of css/desktop-app-ecalc.css (tokens only).

   ECalcPinoutDraw.layout(shape, pins, {view}) -> the geometry of the drawing, plain data without markup:

            the mirror image about the vertical axis: every x of a contact, a number, a name, a leader and a wire stub becomes
            width - x, the names change their side (start <-> end) and no text is ever flipped. Only the shell (paths without
            text) is mirrored by the transform of its own group. A contact keeps its height.
   ECalcPinoutDraw.svg(spec) -> SVG markup. spec: {layout, types: {id: {hex, ink}}, wires: {id: {hex, stripe}}, label}. One
     g.ec-pin per contact (data-pin, data-type, data-num="in" | "out"); the page toggles data-hover, data-selected and data-dim on it.
   ECalcPinoutDraw.OUTLINES -> the sixteen outlines of `rows` (the list of ecalc.PinoutOutlines).
   ECalcPinoutDraw.fitNumber(text, kind, width, height) -> the font size (11, 10 or 9) at which the number fits inside a contact
     of that kind, or 0 when it does not: the page and the tests use the same rule as the drawing.

   The rule for the numbers: a number is written inside its contact at the largest of 11, 10 and 9 units at which its estimated
   width (digits 0.6 em, capitals 0.72 em, narrow signs 0.36 em) fits the contact (a round contact: 84 percent of its diameter,
   any other: width - 4) and its height fits too. When no size fits (a blade of a USB-C contact, an HDMI contact) the number moves

    const round = value => Math.round(value * 100) / 100;

    const OUTLINES = ['displayport', 'dsub', 'hdmi_a', 'jst', 'minifit', 'molex', 'obd2', 'rect', 'rj45', 'sata_data', 'sata_power', 'usb_a', 'usb_b', 'usb_c', 'usb_micro_b', 'usb_mini_b'];

        usb_a: { p: 26, rp: 24, padX: 12, padT: 12, padB: 24, bladeH: 16, cap: 21 },
        usb_b: { p: 26, rp: 26, padX: 14, padT: 14, padB: 12, bladeH: 16, cap: 21 },
        usb_mini_b: { p: 24, rp: 22, padX: 14, padT: 12, padB: 12, bladeH: 16, cap: 21 },
        usb_micro_b: { p: 24, rp: 22, padX: 14, padT: 12, padB: 12, bladeH: 14, cap: 21 },
        usb_c: { p: 22, rp: 26, padX: 26, padT: 10, padB: 10, bladeH: 16, cap: 20 },
        hdmi_a: { p: 22, rp: 26, padX: 18, padT: 10, padB: 10, bladeH: 16, cap: 20 },
        displayport: { p: 22, rp: 26, padX: 16, padT: 10, padB: 10, bladeH: 16, cap: 20 },
        rj45: { p: 22, rp: 26, padX: 12, padT: 10, padB: 20, bladeH: 22, cap: 20 },
        sata_data: { p: 22, rp: 24, padX: 10, padT: 8, padB: 18, bladeH: 14, cap: 20 },
        sata_power: { p: 22, rp: 24, padX: 10, padT: 8, padB: 18, bladeH: 14, cap: 20 },
        molex: { p: 34, rp: 34, padX: 14, padT: 12, padB: 16, bladeH: 20, cap: 26 },
        minifit: { p: 30, rp: 30, padX: 12, padT: 16, padB: 12, bladeH: 20, cap: 24 },

        // 8P8C: contacts at the top, the latch slot in the bottom edge.
        rj45(b) {
            const cx = b.x + b.w / 2, half = Math.max(10, b.w * 0.17), depth = 10;
            return [{ cls: 'ec-shell', d: points([[b.x, b.y], [b.x + b.w, b.y], [b.x + b.w, b.y + b.h], [cx + half, b.y + b.h], [cx + half, b.y + b.h - depth], [cx - half, b.y + b.h - depth], [cx - half, b.y + b.h], [b.x, b.y + b.h]]) }];
        },
        // SATA data plug: the L, the step at the right.
        sata_data(b) {
            const kw = b.w * 0.2, step = 14;
            return [{ cls: 'ec-shell', d: points([[b.x, b.y], [b.x + b.w, b.y], [b.x + b.w, b.y + b.h - step], [b.x + b.w - kw, b.y + b.h - step], [b.x + b.w - kw, b.y + b.h], [b.x, b.y + b.h]]) }];
        },
        // SATA power plug: the same L, the step at the left.
        sata_power(b) {
            const kw = b.w * 0.14, step = 14;
            return [{ cls: 'ec-shell', d: points([[b.x, b.y], [b.x + b.w, b.y], [b.x + b.w, b.y + b.h], [b.x + kw, b.y + b.h], [b.x + kw, b.y + b.h - step], [b.x, b.y + b.h - step]]) }];
        },
        // Peripheral power: two cut corners on one long side.
        molex(b) {
            const c = 14;
            return [{ cls: 'ec-shell', d: points([[b.x, b.y], [b.x + b.w, b.y], [b.x + b.w, b.y + b.h - c], [b.x + b.w - c, b.y + b.h], [b.x + c, b.y + b.h], [b.x, b.y + b.h - c]]) }];
        },
        // Mini-Fit: the latch on top, small cuts at the lower corners.
        minifit(b) {
            const cx = b.x + b.w / 2, c = 7;
            return [
                { cls: 'ec-shell-latch', d: roundRect(cx - 14, b.y - 7, 28, 10, 2) },
                { cls: 'ec-shell', d: points([[b.x, b.y], [b.x + b.w, b.y], [b.x + b.w, b.y + b.h - c], [b.x + b.w - c, b.y + b.h], [b.x + c, b.y + b.h], [b.x, b.y + b.h - c]]) }
            ];
        },
        // The trapezoid of the diagnostic socket with the small latch on the wide side.
        obd2(b, ctx) {
            const inset = slantInset(ctx, b.h * 0.26), cx = b.x + b.w / 2;
            return [
                { cls: 'ec-shell-latch', d: roundRect(cx - 10, b.y - 6, 20, 9, 2) },
                { cls: 'ec-shell', d: points([[b.x, b.y], [b.x + b.w, b.y], [b.x + b.w - inset, b.y + b.h], [b.x + inset, b.y + b.h]]) }
            ];
        },
        // A small housing: the locking ramp on top and the slot around the contacts.
        jst(b) {
            const cx = b.x + b.w / 2;
            return [
                { cls: 'ec-shell', d: points([[b.x, b.y], [cx - 12, b.y], [cx - 6, b.y - 6], [cx + 6, b.y - 6], [cx + 12, b.y], [b.x + b.w, b.y], [b.x + b.w, b.y + b.h], [b.x, b.y + b.h]]) },
                { cls: 'ec-shell-tongue', d: roundRect(b.x + 5, b.y + 6, b.w - 10, b.h - 12, 2) }
            ];
        }
    };

    function layoutRows(shape, map) {
        const style = ROW_STYLE[shape.outline] || ROW_STYLE.rect;
        const kind = shape.contact === 'blade' || shape.contact === 'square' ? shape.contact : 'round';
        const dims = contactDims(kind, style), p = style.p, rp = style.rp;
        const rows = (Array.isArray(shape.rows) ? shape.rows : []).map(row => ({ pins: Array.isArray(row.pins) ? row.pins : [], offset: Number(row.offset) || 0 }));
        const count = rows.length;
        const cols = Math.max(1, ...rows.map(row => row.pins.length + row.offset));
        const named = number => (map.get(String(number)) || {}).name || '';
        const namesMode = count > 0 && rows.every(row => row.pins.length <= 2) && rows.some(row => row.pins.some(number => given(number) && named(number)));

        // 1. the numbers and the wire stubs decide the space above and below
        const records = [];
        let outsideTop = false, outsideBottom = false, stubTop = false, stubBottom = false, stubLeft = false;
        // A single column (a servo, a Qwiic plug) has its wires leave to the left, where no name stands.
        const column = count > 0 && rows.every(row => row.pins.length === 1);
        rows.forEach((row, r) => row.pins.forEach((number, c) => {
            if (!given(number)) return;
            const fs = fitNumber(String(number), kind, dims.w, dims.h);
            const side = fs ? '' : (r === 0 ? 'top' : r === count - 1 ? 'bottom' : '');
            if (side === 'top') outsideTop = true;
            if (side === 'bottom') outsideBottom = true;
            const wire = (map.get(String(number)) || {}).wire;
            const stub = !wire ? '' : column ? 'left' : r === count - 1 ? 'down' : r === 0 ? 'up' : '';
            const stubbed = stub && !(stub === 'up' && side === 'top') && !(stub === 'down' && side === 'bottom') ? stub : '';
            if (stubbed === 'up') stubTop = true;
            if (stubbed === 'down') stubBottom = true;
            if (stubbed === 'left') stubLeft = true;
            records.push({ number: String(number), r, c, off: row.offset, fs, side, stub: stubbed });
        }));
        const padT = style.padT + (outsideTop ? OUT_ROOM : 0), padB = style.padB + (outsideBottom ? OUT_ROOM : 0);
        const sw = 2 * style.padX + (cols - 1) * p + dims.w, sh = padT + padB + (count - 1) * rp + dims.h;
        const ears = style.ears || 0;

        // 2. the room for the names beside the contacts
        let leftW = 0, rightW = 0;
        const sideOf = (row, c) => (row.pins.length === 2 && c === 0 ? 'left' : 'right');
        if (namesMode) {
            rows.forEach(row => row.pins.forEach((number, c) => {
                if (!given(number) || !named(number)) return;
                const room = textWidth(named(number), NAME_FS) + 14;
                if (sideOf(row, c) === 'left') leftW = Math.max(leftW, room); else rightW = Math.max(rightW, room);
            }));
        }
        const ox = MARGIN + leftW + ears + (stubLeft ? STUB : 0), oy = MARGIN + (stubTop ? STUB : 0);
        const width = ox + sw + ears + rightW + MARGIN, height = oy + sh + (stubBottom ? STUB : 0) + MARGIN;

        // 3. the contacts
        const contacts = records.map(rec => {
            const x = ox + style.padX + dims.w / 2 + (rec.c + rec.off) * p, y = oy + padT + dims.h / 2 + rec.r * rp;
            const c = contact(map, rec.number, { shape: kind === 'blade' ? 'rect' : kind === 'round' ? 'circle' : 'rect', kind, x, y, w: dims.w, h: dims.h, r: kind === 'blade' ? 2 : 3 });
            if (rec.fs) inside(c, rec.fs);
            else if (rec.side === 'top') c.num = { mode: 'out', x, y: y - dims.h / 2 - 4, fs: OUT_FS };
            else if (rec.side === 'bottom') c.num = { mode: 'out', x, y: y + dims.h / 2 + 4 + OUT_FS * 0.8, fs: OUT_FS };
            else inside(c, 8);
            if (rec.stub === 'left') c.stub = { x: ox - STUB, y: y - 3.5, w: x - dims.w / 2 - (ox - STUB), h: 7 };
            else if (rec.stub === 'down') c.stub = { x: x - 3.5, y: y + dims.h / 2, w: 7, h: oy + sh + STUB - (y + dims.h / 2) };
            else if (rec.stub === 'up') c.stub = { x: x - 3.5, y: oy - STUB, w: 7, h: y - dims.h / 2 - (oy - STUB) };
            if (namesMode && c.name) {
                const row = rows[rec.r], side = sideOf(row, rec.c);
                if (side === 'left') {
                    c.label = { x: ox - ears - 8, y: y + NAME_FS * 0.36, anchor: 'end', rotate: 0 };
                    c.leader = { x1: x - dims.w / 2, y1: y, x2: ox - ears - 5, y2: y };
                } else {
                    c.label = { x: ox + sw + ears + 8, y: y + NAME_FS * 0.36, anchor: 'start', rotate: 0 };
                    c.leader = { x1: x + dims.w / 2, y1: y, x2: ox + sw + ears + 5, y2: y };
                }
            }
            return c;
        });
        markFirst(contacts);

        // 4. the shell around them
        const rowsBox = rows.map((row, r) => {
            const at = row.pins.map((number, c) => (given(number) ? c : -1)).filter(c => c >= 0);
            if (!at.length) return { l: 0, r: sw, b: 0 };
            return { l: style.padX + (Math.min(...at) + row.offset) * p, r: style.padX + (Math.max(...at) + row.offset) * p + dims.w, b: padT + r * rp + dims.h };
        });
        const key = shape.key && shape.key !== 'none' ? shape.key : '';
        const build = SHELLS[shape.outline] || SHELLS.rect;
        const shell = build({ x: ox, y: oy, w: sw, h: sh }, { w: sw, h: sh, rowsBox, ears, key });
        return { width, height, shellBox: [ox - ears, oy, ox + sw + ears, oy + sh], shell, texts: [], contacts, mirrorable: true };
    }

    // ---- circular ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function layoutCircular(shape, map) {
        const positions = Array.isArray(shape.positions) ? shape.positions : [];
        const unit = positions.map(position => {
            const angle = (Number(position.angle) || 0) * Math.PI / 180, radius = Number(position.radius) || 0;
            return { pin: String(position.pin), x: radius * Math.sin(angle), y: -radius * Math.cos(angle) };
        });
        // The ring is as large as the closest pair of contacts needs (22 units apart at least).
        let closest = Infinity;
        unit.forEach((a, i) => unit.forEach((b, j) => { if (j > i) closest = Math.min(closest, Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y)); }));
        const reach = Math.min(120, Math.max(54, Number.isFinite(closest) && closest > 0 ? 24 / closest : 54));
        const rim = reach + 20, size = Math.min(22, Math.max(14, Number.isFinite(closest) ? closest * reach - 3 : 22));
        const cx = MARGIN + rim + 10, cy = MARGIN + rim + 10, width = 2 * cx, height = 2 * cy;
        const contacts = unit.map(u => {
            const c = contact(map, u.pin, { shape: 'circle', kind: 'round', x: cx + u.x * reach, y: cy + u.y * reach, w: size, h: size });
            return inside(c, fitNumber(c.number, 'round', c.w, c.h) || 8);
        });
        markFirst(contacts);
        const shell = [{ cls: 'ec-shell', d: circle(cx, cy, rim) }, { cls: 'ec-shell-tongue', d: circle(cx, cy, rim - 8) }];
        if (shape.key !== null && shape.key !== undefined && shape.key !== '' && Number.isFinite(Number(shape.key))) {
            // the key notch: a small tab across the rim, turned to the angle
            const degrees = Number(shape.key), angle = degrees * Math.PI / 180;
            shell.push({ cls: 'ec-shell-key', d: 'M-6 -7H6V7H-6Z', at: [round(cx + rim * Math.sin(angle)), round(cy - rim * Math.cos(angle)), round(degrees)] });
        }
        return { width, height, shellBox: [cx - rim, cy - rim, cx + rim, cy + rim], shell, texts: [], contacts, mirrorable: true };
    }

    // ---- dip --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function layoutDip(shape, map) {
        const n = Math.max(4, Number(shape.pins) || 0), half = n / 2, pitch = 24, leg = { w: 26, h: 16 }, bodyW = 64;
        const names = i => (map.get(String(i)) || {}).name || '';
        let leftW = 0, rightW = 0;
        for (let i = 1; i <= half; i++) leftW = Math.max(leftW, textWidth(names(i), NAME_FS) + 14);
        for (let i = half + 1; i <= n; i++) rightW = Math.max(rightW, textWidth(names(i), NAME_FS) + 14);
        const bx = MARGIN + leftW + leg.w - 6, by = MARGIN + 6, bodyH = half * pitch + 8;
        const width = bx + bodyW + leg.w - 6 + rightW + MARGIN, height = by + bodyH + MARGIN + 6;
        const cx = bx + bodyW / 2, r = 9;
        const contacts = [];
        for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            const left = i <= half, row = left ? i - 1 : n - i;
            const x = left ? bx - leg.w / 2 + 6 : bx + bodyW + leg.w / 2 - 6, y = by + 4 + pitch / 2 + row * pitch;
            const c = inside(contact(map, i, { shape: 'rect', kind: 'square', x, y, w: leg.w, h: leg.h, r: 1.5 }), fitNumber(String(i), 'square', leg.w, leg.h) || 9);
            c.label = left ? { x: bx - leg.w + 6 - 6, y: y + NAME_FS * 0.36, anchor: 'end', rotate: 0 } : { x: bx + bodyW + leg.w - 6 + 6, y: y + NAME_FS * 0.36, anchor: 'start', rotate: 0 };
            contacts.push(c);
        }
        markFirst(contacts);
        const body = 'M' + bx + ' ' + by + 'H' + (cx - r) + 'A' + r + ' ' + r + ' 0 0 0 ' + (cx + r) + ' ' + by + 'H' + (bx + bodyW) + 'V' + (by + bodyH) + 'H' + bx + 'Z';
        const shell = [{ cls: 'ec-shell', d: body }, { cls: 'ec-shell-hole', d: circle(bx + 11, by + 15, 3) }];
        return { width, height, shellBox: [bx - leg.w + 6, by, bx + bodyW + leg.w - 6, by + bodyH], shell, texts: [], contacts, mirrorable: false };
    }

    // ---- staggered names under leads (to, jack) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    // The names hang below the contacts on leader lines of different length: the first pin has the longest leader, so that no
    // name crosses the leader of another pin.
    function staggerNames(contacts, top, step) {
        const count = contacts.length;
        let reach = 0;
        contacts.forEach((c, index) => {
            const level = top + (count - 1 - index) * step + 12;
            c.leader = { x1: c.x, y1: c.y + c.h / 2, x2: c.x, y2: level - 4 };
            c.label = { x: c.x + 6, y: level + NAME_FS * 0.3, anchor: 'start', rotate: 0 };
            reach = Math.max(reach, c.x + 6 + textWidth(c.name, NAME_FS));
        });
        return { reach, bottom: top + (count - 1) * step + 12 + 8 };
    }

    // ---- to ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function layoutTo(shape, map) {
        const numbers = (Array.isArray(shape.pins) ? shape.pins : []).map(String), n = Math.max(numbers.length, 2), gap = 28;
        const is220 = shape.package === 'to220';
        const bodyW = Math.max(is220 ? 76 : 64, (n - 1) * gap + (is220 ? 40 : 36));
        const x0 = MARGIN, y0 = MARGIN, cx = x0 + bodyW / 2;
        const shell = [], leadTop = is220 ? y0 + 86 : y0 + bodyW / 2 + 24;
        if (is220) {
            shell.push({ cls: 'ec-shell-tab', d: roundRect(x0, y0, bodyW, 40, 3) }, { cls: 'ec-shell-hole', d: circle(cx, y0 + 17, 6) }, { cls: 'ec-shell', d: roundRect(x0, y0 + 40, bodyW, 46, 2) });
        } else {
            const r = bodyW / 2;
            shell.push({ cls: 'ec-shell', d: 'M' + x0 + ' ' + (y0 + r) + 'A' + r + ' ' + r + ' 0 0 1 ' + (x0 + bodyW) + ' ' + (y0 + r) + 'V' + (y0 + r + 24) + 'H' + x0 + 'Z' });
        }
        const size = { w: 26, h: 20 }, leadLen = 14;
        const contacts = numbers.map((number, i) => {
            const x = cx + (i - (numbers.length - 1) / 2) * gap, y = leadTop + leadLen + size.h / 2;
            shell.push({ cls: 'ec-shell-lead', d: 'M' + round(x) + ' ' + round(leadTop - 1) + 'V' + round(y) });
            return inside(contact(map, number, { shape: 'rect', kind: 'square', x, y, w: size.w, h: size.h, r: 2 }), fitNumber(number, 'square', size.w, size.h) || 9);
        });
        markFirst(contacts);
        const names = staggerNames(contacts, leadTop + leadLen + size.h + 6, 16);
        const width = Math.max(x0 + bodyW, names.reach) + MARGIN, height = names.bottom + MARGIN;
        return { width, height, shellBox: [x0, y0, x0 + bodyW, leadTop], shell, texts: [], contacts, mirrorable: false };
    }

    // ---- jack ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function layoutJack(shape, map) {
        const numbers = (Array.isArray(shape.segments) ? shape.segments : []).map(String), n = Math.max(numbers.length, 2);
        const half = 14, gap = 7, tip = 36, ring = 24, sleeve = 72, handle = 64;
        const x0 = MARGIN + 4, cy = MARGIN + half + 18;
        const shell = [], contacts = [];
        let x = x0;
        numbers.forEach((number, i) => {
            const last = i === n - 1, w = i === 0 ? tip : last ? sleeve : ring;
            const mid = x + w / 2;
            const d = i === 0
                ? 'M' + (x + w) + ' ' + (cy - half) + 'H' + (x + half) + 'A' + half + ' ' + half + ' 0 0 0 ' + (x + half) + ' ' + (cy + half) + 'H' + (x + w) + 'Z'
                : 'M' + x + ' ' + (cy - half) + 'H' + (x + w) + 'V' + (cy + half) + 'H' + x + 'Z';
            const c = contact(map, number, { shape: 'path', kind: 'square', x: mid + (i === 0 ? half / 2 : 0), y: cy, w: w - (i === 0 ? half : 0), h: half * 2, d });
            const fs = fitNumber(number, 'square', c.w, c.h);
            if (fs) inside(c, fs); else c.num = { mode: 'out', x: c.x, y: cy - half - 4, fs: OUT_FS };
            contacts.push(c);
            x += w;
            if (!last) { shell.push({ cls: 'ec-shell-insulator', d: 'M' + x + ' ' + (cy - half) + 'h' + gap + 'v' + half * 2 + 'h' + (-gap) + 'Z' }); x += gap; }
        });
        shell.push({ cls: 'ec-shell', d: roundRect(x, cy - 20, handle, 40, 5) });
        markFirst(contacts);
        const names = staggerNames(contacts, cy + half + 6, 16);
        const width = Math.max(x + handle, names.reach) + MARGIN, height = names.bottom + MARGIN;
        return { width, height, shellBox: [x0, cy - 20, x + handle, cy + 20], shell, texts: [], contacts, mirrorable: false };
    }

    // ---- board ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function layoutBoard(shape, map) {
        const lists = { left: shape.left || [], right: shape.right || [], top: shape.top || [], bottom: shape.bottom || [] };
        const pitch = 24, h = 18;
        const all = [];
        for (const side of ['left', 'right', 'top', 'bottom']) lists[side].forEach(number => { if (given(number)) all.push(String(number)); });
        const inner = Array.isArray(shape.inner) ? shape.inner : [];
        // the pads of the inner headers are as wide as their longest number needs (ICSP.2 is no "2")
        const innerNumbers = [];
        inner.forEach(group => (group.rows || []).forEach(row => (row.pins || []).forEach(number => { if (given(number)) innerNumbers.push(String(number)); })));
        const iw = Math.max(18, ...innerNumbers.map(number => textWidth(number, 10) + 8)), ipitch = iw + 4;
        inner.forEach(group => (group.rows || []).forEach(row => (row.pins || []).forEach(number => { if (given(number)) all.push(String(number)); })));
        const w = Math.max(18, ...all.map(number => textWidth(number, 10) + 8));
        const nameWidth = side => Math.max(0, ...lists[side].filter(given).map(number => textWidth((map.get(String(number)) || {}).name || '', NAME_FS)));
        const margin = {
            left: MARGIN + (lists.left.some(given) ? nameWidth('left') + 12 + w / 2 : 0),
            right: MARGIN + (lists.right.some(given) ? nameWidth('right') + 12 + w / 2 : 0),
            top: MARGIN + (lists.top.some(given) ? nameWidth('top') + 12 + h / 2 : 0),
            bottom: MARGIN + (lists.bottom.some(given) ? nameWidth('bottom') + 12 + h / 2 : 0)
        };
        const connector = ['top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right'].includes(shape.connector) ? shape.connector : 'none';
        const protrude = connector !== 'none' && !lists[connector].some(given) ? 14 : 0;
        margin[connector === 'none' ? 'top' : connector] = Math.max(margin[connector === 'none' ? 'top' : connector], MARGIN + protrude);
        // the inner headers
        const innerSize = inner.map(group => {
            const rows = group.rows || [];
            const cols = Math.max(1, ...rows.map(row => (row.pins || []).length + (Number(row.offset) || 0)));
            return { cols, rows: rows.length, w: (cols - 1) * ipitch + iw, h: (rows.length - 1) * 22 + 18 + 16 };
        });
        const innerW = Math.max(0, ...innerSize.map(size => size.w)), innerH = innerSize.reduce((sum, size) => sum + size.h + 8, 0);
        const bodyW = Math.max(130, Math.max(lists.top.length, lists.bottom.length) * pitch + 40, innerW + 2 * (w + 14) + 20);
        const bodyH = Math.max(150, Math.max(lists.left.length, lists.right.length) * pitch + 40, innerH + 60);
        const bx = margin.left, by = margin.top;
        const width = bx + bodyW + margin.right, height = by + bodyH + margin.bottom;
        const shell = [{ cls: 'ec-shell', d: roundRect(bx, by, bodyW, bodyH, 6) }];
        const ccx = bx + bodyW / 2, ccy = by + bodyH / 2;
        if (connector !== 'none') {
            const inward = 22, out = protrude;
            if (connector === 'top') shell.unshift({ cls: 'ec-shell-conn', d: roundRect(ccx - 26, by - out, 52, out + inward, 3) });
            if (connector === 'bottom') shell.unshift({ cls: 'ec-shell-conn', d: roundRect(ccx - 26, by + bodyH - inward, 52, out + inward, 3) });
            if (connector === 'left') shell.unshift({ cls: 'ec-shell-conn', d: roundRect(bx - out, ccy - 26, out + inward, 52, 3) });
            if (connector === 'right') shell.unshift({ cls: 'ec-shell-conn', d: roundRect(bx + bodyW - inward, ccy - 26, out + inward, 52, 3) });
        }
        const contacts = [];
        const add = (number, x, y, label, size) => {
            const c = contact(map, number, { shape: 'rect', kind: 'square', x, y, w: size.w, h: size.h, r: 3 });
            inside(c, fitNumber(String(number), 'square', size.w, size.h) || 9);
            c.label = label;
            contacts.push(c);
        };
        const gap = (side, i) => (side === 'left' || side === 'right' ? by + 20 + i * pitch + pitch / 2 : bx + 20 + i * pitch + pitch / 2);
        lists.left.forEach((number, i) => { if (given(number)) add(number, bx, gap('left', i), { x: bx - w / 2 - 6, y: gap('left', i) + NAME_FS * 0.36, anchor: 'end', rotate: 0 }, { w, h }); });
        lists.right.forEach((number, i) => { if (given(number)) add(number, bx + bodyW, gap('right', i), { x: bx + bodyW + w / 2 + 6, y: gap('right', i) + NAME_FS * 0.36, anchor: 'start', rotate: 0 }, { w, h }); });
        lists.top.forEach((number, i) => { if (given(number)) add(number, gap('top', i), by, { x: gap('top', i) + NAME_FS * 0.36, y: by - h / 2 - 6, anchor: 'start', rotate: -90 }, { w, h }); });
        lists.bottom.forEach((number, i) => { if (given(number)) add(number, gap('bottom', i), by + bodyH, { x: gap('bottom', i) - NAME_FS * 0.36, y: by + bodyH + h / 2 + 6, anchor: 'start', rotate: 90 }, { w, h }); });
        const texts = [];
        let y = ccy - innerH / 2 + 4;
        inner.forEach((group, index) => {
            const size = innerSize[index], left = ccx - size.w / 2;
            texts.push({ x: ccx, y: y + 10, text: String(group.label || ''), cls: 'ec-pin-inner-label', anchor: 'middle' });
            (group.rows || []).forEach((row, r) => (row.pins || []).forEach((number, c) => {
                if (!given(number)) return;
                add(number, left + iw / 2 + (c + (Number(row.offset) || 0)) * ipitch, y + 16 + 9 + r * 22, null, { w: iw, h: 18 });
            }));
            y += size.h + 8;
        });
        markFirst(contacts);
        return { width, height, shellBox: [bx, by, bx + bodyW, by + bodyH], shell, texts, contacts, mirrorable: false };
    }

    // ---- layout and mirror image ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    const LAYOUTS = { rows: layoutRows, circular: layoutCircular, dip: layoutDip, to: layoutTo, jack: layoutJack, board: layoutBoard };

    function mirror(result) {
        const width = result.width, flip = x => width - x;
        for (const c of result.contacts) {
            c.x = flip(c.x);
            c.num = Object.assign({}, c.num, { x: flip(c.num.x) });
            if (c.label) c.label = Object.assign({}, c.label, { x: flip(c.label.x), anchor: c.label.anchor === 'start' ? 'end' : c.label.anchor === 'end' ? 'start' : 'middle' });
            if (c.leader) c.leader = { x1: flip(c.leader.x1), y1: c.leader.y1, x2: flip(c.leader.x2), y2: c.leader.y2 };
            if (c.stub) c.stub = Object.assign({}, c.stub, { x: flip(c.stub.x + c.stub.w) });
        }
        result.shellBox = [flip(result.shellBox[2]), result.shellBox[1], flip(result.shellBox[0]), result.shellBox[3]];
        result.mirrored = true;
    }

    function layout(shape, pins, options) {
        const type = shape && shape.type;
        const build = LAYOUTS[type];
        if (!build) return { type: type || '', view: '', mirrored: false, width: 0, height: 0, shellBox: [0, 0, 0, 0], shell: [], texts: [], contacts: [] };
        const result = build(shape, pinMap(pins));
        const view = options && (options.view === 'plug' || options.view === 'socket') ? options.view : shape.drawn;
        result.type = type;
        result.view = result.mirrorable ? view : shape.drawn;
        result.mirrored = false;
        result.width = Math.ceil(result.width); // whole units first: the mirror image is about the middle of the viewBox
        result.height = Math.ceil(result.height);
        if (result.mirrorable && view !== shape.drawn && (view === 'plug' || view === 'socket')) mirror(result);
        delete result.mirrorable;
        for (const c of result.contacts) { c.x = round(c.x); c.y = round(c.y); }
        return result;
    }

    // ---- markup -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    // The body of a contact, `grow` units larger on every side (the selection ring).
    function bodyMarkup(c, cls, grow, extra) {
        const g = grow || 0, tail = extra || '';
        if (c.shape === 'circle') return '<circle class="' + cls + '" cx="' + c.x + '" cy="' + c.y + '" r="' + round(c.w / 2 + g) + '"' + tail + '/>';
        if (c.shape === 'path') return '<path class="' + cls + '" d="' + c.d + '"' + tail + '/>';
        return '<rect class="' + cls + '" x="' + round(c.x - c.w / 2 - g) + '" y="' + round(c.y - c.h / 2 - g) + '" width="' + round(c.w + 2 * g) + '" height="' + round(c.h + 2 * g) + '" rx="' + round(c.r + g) + '"' + tail + '/>';
    }
    function pinMarkup(c, types, wires) {
        const style = types[c.type] || types.nc || {};
        const hex = safeColor(style.hex) || FALLBACK_HEX, ink = safeColor(style.ink) || FALLBACK_INK;
        const out = c.num.mode === 'out';
        let markup = '<g class="ec-pin" data-pin="' + escape(c.number) + '" data-type="' + escape(c.type) + '" data-num="' + c.num.mode + '">';
        if (c.stub) {
            const wire = wires[c.wire] || {}, base = safeColor(wire.hex), stripe = safeColor(wire.stripe);
            if (base) {
                const st = c.stub, horizontal = st.w > st.h;
                markup += '<g class="ec-wire-stub" data-wire="' + escape(c.wire) + '"><rect class="ec-wire-base" x="' + round(st.x) + '" y="' + round(st.y) + '" width="' + round(st.w) + '" height="' + round(st.h) + '" rx="1.5" fill="' + base + '"/>'
                    + (stripe ? '<rect class="ec-wire-stripe" x="' + round(horizontal ? st.x : st.x + st.w / 2 - 1.2) + '" y="' + round(horizontal ? st.y + st.h / 2 - 1.2 : st.y) + '" width="' + (horizontal ? round(st.w) : 2.4) + '" height="' + (horizontal ? 2.4 : round(st.h)) + '" fill="' + stripe + '"/>' : '') + '</g>';
            }
        }
        if (c.leader) markup += '<path class="ec-leader" d="M' + round(c.leader.x1) + ' ' + round(c.leader.y1) + 'L' + round(c.leader.x2) + ' ' + round(c.leader.y2) + '"/>';
        markup += '<rect class="ec-pin-hit" x="' + round(c.x - c.w / 2 - 3) + '" y="' + round(c.y - c.h / 2 - 3) + '" width="' + (c.w + 6) + '" height="' + (c.h + 6) + '"/>';
        markup += bodyMarkup(c, 'ec-pin-body', 0, ' fill="' + hex + '"');
        markup += bodyMarkup(c, 'ec-pin-ring', c.shape === 'path' ? 0 : 3);
        // The mark sits at the upper left corner, or at the lower left one when the number stands above the contact.
        if (c.mark) markup += c.num.mode === 'out' && c.num.y < c.y
            ? '<path class="ec-pin-mark" d="M' + round(c.x - c.w / 2 - 4) + ' ' + round(c.y + c.h / 2 + 4) + 'h9l-9 -9Z"/>'
            : '<path class="ec-pin-mark" d="M' + round(c.x - c.w / 2 - 4) + ' ' + round(c.y - c.h / 2 - 4) + 'h9l-9 9Z"/>';
        markup += '<text class="ec-pin-num' + (out ? ' ec-pin-num-out' : '') + '" x="' + round(c.num.x) + '" y="' + round(c.num.y) + '" text-anchor="middle" font-size="' + c.num.fs + '"' + (out ? '' : ' fill="' + ink + '"') + '>' + escape(c.number) + '</text>';
        if (c.label && c.name) {
            const turn = c.label.rotate ? ' transform="rotate(' + c.label.rotate + ' ' + round(c.label.x) + ' ' + round(c.label.y) + ')"' : '';
            markup += '<text class="ec-pin-name" x="' + round(c.label.x) + '" y="' + round(c.label.y) + '" text-anchor="' + c.label.anchor + '" font-size="' + NAME_FS + '"' + turn + '>' + escape(c.name) + '</text>';
        }
        return markup + '</g>';
    }

    function svg(spec) {
        const view = spec && spec.layout;
        if (!view || !view.width || !view.height) return '';
        const types = spec.types || {}, wires = spec.wires || {};
        const flip = view.mirrored ? ' transform="translate(' + view.width + ' 0) scale(-1 1)"' : '';
        const shell = view.shell.map(part => {
            if (part.at) return '<path class="' + part.cls + '" d="' + part.d + '" transform="translate(' + part.at[0] + ' ' + part.at[1] + ') rotate(' + part.at[2] + ')"/>';
            return '<path class="' + part.cls + '" d="' + part.d + '"/>';
        }).join('');
        return '<svg class="ec-pin-art" data-shape="' + escape(view.type) + '" data-view="' + escape(view.view) + '" viewBox="0 0 ' + view.width + ' ' + view.height + '" width="' + view.width + '" height="' + view.height + '" role="img" aria-label="' + escape(spec.label || '') + '" focusable="false">'
            + '<g class="ec-pin-shell"' + flip + '>' + shell + '</g>'
            + view.texts.map(text => '<text class="' + text.cls + '" x="' + round(text.x) + '" y="' + round(text.y) + '" text-anchor="' + text.anchor + '" font-size="10">' + escape(text.text) + '</text>').join('')
            + view.contacts.map(c => pinMarkup(c, types, wires)).join('')
            + '</svg>';
    }

    window.ECalcPinoutDraw = { layout, svg, OUTLINES, fitNumber, safeColor, textWidth };
})();
```

```go
package ui

import (
```
