```go
// ecalcPinoutKeys lists every desktop.* string of the pinout pages (ECalc phase 4): the sections of the Pinouts list and the
// strings of the page. The names of the pin types and of the wire colours come from the catalog, not from here.
var ecalcPinoutKeys = []string{
	"desktop.ecalc_group_audio", "desktop.ecalc_group_boards", "desktop.ecalc_group_data", "desktop.ecalc_group_debug", "desktop.ecalc_group_ics", "desktop.ecalc_group_pc_power",
	"desktop.ecalc_pin_copy", "desktop.ecalc_pin_drawing", "desktop.ecalc_pin_face", "desktop.ecalc_pin_filter", "desktop.ecalc_pin_function", "desktop.ecalc_pin_legend",
	"desktop.ecalc_pin_name", "desktop.ecalc_pin_no_match", "desktop.ecalc_pin_notes", "desktop.ecalc_pin_number", "desktop.ecalc_pin_pick", "desktop.ecalc_pin_rows",
	"desktop.ecalc_pin_rows_filtered", "desktop.ecalc_pin_select", "desktop.ecalc_pin_type", "desktop.ecalc_pin_variant", "desktop.ecalc_pin_view", "desktop.ecalc_pin_wire",
}

var ecalcPinoutPlaceholders = map[string][]string{
	"desktop.ecalc_pin_drawing":       {"{name}", "{count}"},
	"desktop.ecalc_pin_rows":          {"{total}"},
	"desktop.ecalc_pin_rows_filtered": {"{shown}", "{total}"},
	"desktop.ecalc_pin_select":        {"{number}"},
}

func TestECalcPinoutLocaleKeys(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	if len(ecalcPinoutKeys) != 24 {
		t.Errorf("%d pinout keys are listed, want the 24 of the plan", len(ecalcPinoutKeys))
	}
	for _, lang := range []string{"cs", "da", "de", "el", "en", "es", "fr", "hi", "it", "ja", "nl", "no", "pl", "pt", "sv", "zh"} {
		words := readMergedLangMap(t, lang)
		for _, key := range ecalcPinoutKeys {
			if strings.TrimSpace(words[key]) == "" {
				t.Errorf("%s misses %s", lang, key)
			}
		}
		for key, placeholders := range ecalcPinoutPlaceholders {
			for _, placeholder := range placeholders {
				if !strings.Contains(words[key], placeholder) {
					t.Errorf("%s: %s must keep the %s placeholder: %q", lang, key, placeholder, words[key])
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// The scripts are wired into the loader after the code page and before the shell, the shell routes the kind and knows the
// six sections of the Pinouts list in the order of ecalc.PinoutGroups.
func TestECalcPinoutPagesAreWired(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	loader := readDesktopAssetText(t, "js/desktop/core/module-loader.js")
	start := strings.Index(loader, "        ecalc: {")
	if start < 0 {
		t.Fatal("module-loader.js has no ecalc entry in DESKTOP_APP_ASSETS")
	}
	entry := loader[start : start+strings.Index(loader[start:], "\n        },")]
	offset := 0
	for _, script := range []string{"ecalc-table-page.js", "ecalc-code-draw.js", "ecalc-code-page.js", "ecalc-pinout-draw.js", "ecalc-pinout-page.js", "ecalc-shell.js", "/ecalc.js'"} {
		index := strings.Index(entry[offset:], script)
		if index < 0 {
			t.Fatalf("the ecalc loader entry lists %s out of order or not at all", script)
		}
		offset += index + len(script)
	}
	scripts := ecalcScripts(t)
	for _, name := range []string{"ecalc-pinout-draw.js", "ecalc-pinout-page.js"} {
		if _, ok := scripts[name]; !ok {
			t.Errorf("%s/%s is missing", ecalcDir, name)
		}
	}
	// The scripts of the app: the 21 of phase 2, the 5 of phase 3 (tables, table page, codes, code draw, code page) and the 2 of phase 4.
	if got := strings.Count(entry, "/js/desktop/apps/ecalc/"); got != 28 {
		t.Errorf("the ecalc loader entry lists %d scripts, want 28", got)
	}
	shell := scripts["ecalc-shell.js"]
	for _, marker := range []string{"window.ECalcPinoutPage || null", "kind === 'pinout'", "pinTypes: catalog.pin_types || [], wires: catalog.wires || []"} {
		if !strings.Contains(shell, marker) {
			t.Errorf("ecalc-shell.js is missing %q", marker)
		}
	}
	match := regexp.MustCompile(`const PINOUT_GROUPS = \[([^\]]*)\];`).FindStringSubmatch(shell)
	if match == nil {
		t.Fatal("ecalc-shell.js has no PINOUT_GROUPS")
	}
	var groups []string
	for _, quoted := range regexp.MustCompile(`'([a-z_]+)'`).FindAllStringSubmatch(match[1], -1) {
		groups = append(groups, quoted[1])
	}
	if !slices.Equal(groups, ecalc.PinoutGroups) {
		t.Errorf("PINOUT_GROUPS = %v, want ecalc.PinoutGroups = %v", groups, ecalc.PinoutGroups)
	}
}

// The drawing is a string builder like the code drawings: no document access, no colour in the code but the two fallbacks for
// a pin type the data does not know, and it draws exactly the outlines that the engine accepts.
func TestECalcPinoutDrawIsADomFreeStringBuilder(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	draw := ecalcScripts(t)["ecalc-pinout-draw.js"]
	for _, marker := range []string{
		"window.ECalcPinoutDraw = { layout, svg, OUTLINES, fitNumber, safeColor, textWidth };", "function layout(shape, pins, options)", "function svg(spec)", "const safeColor =",
		`class="ec-pin"`, `class="ec-pin-hit"`, `'ec-pin-body'`, `'ec-pin-ring'`, `class="ec-pin-mark"`, `class="ec-pin-shell"`, `class="ec-pin-art"`, `class="ec-leader"`, `class="ec-wire-stub"`,
		`' fill="' + hex + '"'`, `data-type="`, `data-pin="`, `role="img"`, "translate(' + view.width + ' 0) scale(-1 1)",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(draw, marker) {
			t.Errorf("ecalc-pinout-draw.js is missing %q", marker)
		}
	}
	body := regexp.MustCompile(`(?s)/\*.*?\*/`).ReplaceAllString(draw, "")
	for label, pattern := range map[string]string{
		"document access": `\bdocument\b`,
		"window access":   `\bwindow\.(?:document|ECalcCore|localStorage)\b`,
		"DOM write":       `\b(?:innerHTML|createElement|appendChild|setAttribute)\b`,
		"colour function": `\b(?:rgba?|hsla?)\(`,
		"inline style":    `\bstyle=`,
		"text transform":  `<text[^>]*scale\(`,
	} {
		if match := regexp.MustCompile(pattern).FindString(body); match != "" {
			t.Errorf("ecalc-pinout-draw.js must not contain a %s (%q)", label, match)
		}
	}
	// Two fallback colours only; the HEX pattern of safeColor is a regular expression, not a colour.
	cleaned := regexp.MustCompile(`const HEX = [^\n]*`).ReplaceAllString(body, "")
	if got := regexp.MustCompile(`#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b`).FindAllString(cleaned, -1); !slices.Equal(got, []string{"#9e9e9e", "#000000"}) {
		t.Errorf("ecalc-pinout-draw.js holds the colours %v, want only the two fallbacks #9e9e9e and #000000", got)
	}
	list := regexp.MustCompile(`const OUTLINES = \[([^\]]*)\];`).FindStringSubmatch(body)
	if list == nil {
		t.Fatal("ecalc-pinout-draw.js has no OUTLINES list")
	}
	var outlines []string
	for _, quoted := range regexp.MustCompile(`'([a-z_0-9]+)'`).FindAllStringSubmatch(list[1], -1) {
		outlines = append(outlines, quoted[1])
	}
	if !slices.Equal(outlines, ecalc.PinoutOutlines) {
		t.Errorf("OUTLINES = %v, want ecalc.PinoutOutlines = %v", outlines, ecalc.PinoutOutlines)
	}
	for _, outline := range ecalc.PinoutOutlines {
		if !regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^\s+`+outline+`\(`).MatchString(body) && !strings.Contains(body, outline+": {") {
			t.Errorf("ecalc-pinout-draw.js has no shell builder for the outline %s", outline)
		}
	}
}

// The page keeps the choices in the store under the item id, speaks only in desktop.ecalc_* keys, and never reaches into the
// theme or writes an inline style.
func TestECalcPinoutPageUsesTheStore(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	page := ecalcScripts(t)["ecalc-pinout-page.js"]
	for _, marker := range []string{
		"window.ECalcPinoutPage = { create };", "store.saveCalc(item.id, { choices: { variant: st.variant, view: st.view } })", "store.calcState(item.id)", `aria-live="polite"`,
		"el.dataset.pinout = item.id;", "Draw.layout(shape, pins, { view: st.view })", "Draw.svg({", `class="ec-pin-rowbtn"`, "CSS.escape(", "window.ECalcCalcPage.copyText(plainText())", "store.flush()",
		"event.key === 'Escape'", "focusFilter()", "layout()", "refresh()", "dispose()",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(page, marker) {
			t.Errorf("ecalc-pinout-page.js is missing %q", marker)
		}
	}
	body := regexp.MustCompile(`(?s)/\*.*?\*/`).ReplaceAllString(page, "")
	for label, pattern := range map[string]string{
		"colour function": `\b(?:rgba?|hsla?)\(`,
		"console call":    `\bconsole\.`,
		"storage access":  `\b(?:localStorage|sessionStorage)\b`,
		"throw":           `\bthrow\b`,
		"inline style":    `\.style\.|\bstyle=`,
		"scrollIntoView":  `\bscrollIntoView\b`,
	} {
		if match := regexp.MustCompile(pattern).FindString(body); match != "" {
			t.Errorf("ecalc-pinout-page.js must not contain a %s (%q)", label, match)
		}
	}
	// Only the colour fallback of the swatch may be a hex colour in the page.
	if got := regexp.MustCompile(`#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b`).FindAllString(body, -1); !slices.Equal(got, []string{"#9e9e9e"}) {
		t.Errorf("ecalc-pinout-page.js holds the colours %v, want only the fallback #9e9e9e", got)
	}
	// Every pinout key (but the group names, which the shell composes) is used by the page, and the page uses no other.
	listed := map[string]bool{}
	for _, key := range ecalcPinoutKeys {
		listed[key] = true
		if !strings.HasPrefix(key, "desktop.ecalc_group_") && !strings.Contains(page, "'"+key+"'") {
			t.Errorf("ecalc-pinout-page.js never uses the key %s", key)
		}
	}
	for _, match := range regexp.MustCompile(`['"](desktop.ecalc_pin_[a-z0-9_]+)['"]`).FindAllStringSubmatch(page, -1) {
		if !listed[match[1]] {
			t.Errorf("ecalc-pinout-page.js uses the key %s, which ecalcPinoutKeys does not list", match[1])
		}
	}
}

// The stylesheet part of the pinouts is the last section of the file, after the code pages, and takes tokens only.
func TestECalcPinoutStylesheetSection(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	css := readDesktopAssetText(t, "css/desktop-app-ecalc.css")
	start, end := strings.Index(css, "/* pinouts */"), strings.LastIndex(css, "/* end of pinouts */")
	if start < 0 || end < start {
		t.Fatal("css/desktop-app-ecalc.css has no /* pinouts */ ... /* end of pinouts */ section")
	}
	if codes := strings.LastIndex(css, "/* end of code pages */"); codes < 0 || codes > start {
		t.Error("the pinouts section follows the code pages section")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(css[end+len("/* end of pinouts */"):]) != "" {
		t.Error("the pinouts section is the last section of css/desktop-app-ecalc.css")
	}
	section := css[start:end]
	for _, marker := range []string{
		".ec-shell {", ".ec-shell-flange {", ".ec-shell-tongue {", ".ec-pin-body {", `.ec-pin[data-type="nc"] .ec-pin-body { stroke-dasharray`, `.ec-pin[data-selected="true"] .ec-pin-ring`,
		`.ec-pin[data-dim="true"]`, ".ec-pin-num-out { fill: var(--vd-text); }", `.ec-pinout-page[data-narrow="false"] .ec-pin-main`, ".ec-pin-art-host {", ".ec-pin-scroll {",
		".ec-pin-rowbtn", `.ec-pin-table tbody tr[data-selected="true"]`, "@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(section, marker) {
			t.Errorf("the pinouts section is missing %q", marker)
		}
	}
	// The fill of a contact and the ink of its number are attributes of the drawing, never a rule of the stylesheet.
	if regexp.MustCompile(`\.ec-pin-body\s*\{[^}]*\bfill\s*:`).MatchString(section) || regexp.MustCompile(`\.ec-pin-num\s*\{[^}]*\bfill\s*:`).MatchString(section) {
		t.Error("the stylesheet must not set the fill of a contact or of the number inside it: the colour comes from the data")
	}
}

// The fixture of the pinout tests covers every outline of rows, every shape type, the two-view and the variant cases, and is the
// same text that the node test and the browser test evaluate.
func TestECalcPinoutFixtureCoversEveryShape(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("..", "scripts", "ecalc-pinout-fixtures.js"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	source := string(raw)
	for _, outline := range ecalc.PinoutOutlines {
		if !strings.Contains(source, "'"+outline+"'") {
			t.Errorf("the fixture has no item with the outline %s", outline)
		}
	}
	for _, kind := range []string{"type: 'circular'", "type: 'dip'", "type: 'to'", "type: 'jack'", "type: 'board'", "package: 'to92'", "package: 'to220'", "contact", "variants"} {
		if !strings.Contains(source, kind) {
			t.Errorf("the fixture never uses %s", kind)
		}
	}
	for _, contact := range []string{"'round'", "'square'", "'blade'"} {
		if !strings.Contains(source, contact) {
			t.Errorf("the fixture has no %s contact", contact)
		}
	}
}
```

`ui/js/desktop/apps/ecalc/ecalc-pinout-page.js`:
```js
/* ECalc pinout page: the title with favorite and "Copy pinout", the short description, the variant selector (an item with
   `variants`), the view toggle (plug / socket, only for a shape that has two views, with the fixed caption "looking at the
   mating face"), the drawing of ECalcPinoutDraw, the legend of the pin types in use, the detail panel of the selected pin
   (aria-live="polite") and the pin table: number, name, function, type chip, wire swatch (the column is hidden when no pin of
   the variant has a wire) and notes. The table stands beside the drawing when the page is wide and under it when it is narrow.
   A pin is found from both sides: hovering a contact or a row highlights both, a click selects (the row of the selected pin is
   scrolled into view inside the table area, never the page). The drawing is pointer-only (role="img", aria-hidden pins); the
   keyboard path is the button in the first cell of every row. The filter box matches number, name, function, type name, wire
   name and notes, dims the other contacts and hides the other rows. The variant and the view are remembered per item
   (store.saveCalc(item.id, {choices: {variant, view}})).
   options: {item, store, t, icon, uid, onFavorite, pinTypes, wires} (the options object of every page creator, see
   ecalc-shell.js; pinTypes and wires are `pin_types` and `wires` of the catalog); returns {el, layout, refresh, focusFilter, dispose}.
   Publishes window.ECalcPinoutPage = { create }. */
(function () {
    'use strict';

    const Typeset = window.ECalcTypeset, esc = Typeset.escape;
    const NARROW_BELOW = 820; // under this width the table stands under the drawing and the buttons show their icon only
    // The drawing is shown between these scales of its natural size (1 unit = 1 px): a small connector is enlarged, a dense one is
    // shrunk to the width of its host but never below MIN_SCALE, below that it scrolls inside its own area (the page never does).
    const MIN_SCALE = 0.72, MAX_SCALE = 1.6, TALL = 640;
    const COPIED_MS = 1600;
    const oneLine = text => String(text == null ? '' : text).replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' ');

    function create(options) {
        const { item, store, t, icon, uid } = options;
        const Draw = window.ECalcPinoutDraw;
        const shape = item.shape || {};
        const typeInfo = new Map((options.pinTypes || []).map(type => [type.id, type]));
        const wireInfo = new Map((options.wires || []).map(wire => [wire.id, wire]));
        const typeName = id => (typeInfo.get(id) || {}).name || id;
        const wireName = id => (wireInfo.get(id) || {}).name || id;
        const variants = Array.isArray(item.variants) ? item.variants : [];
        const twoViews = !!item.views && (shape.type === 'rows' || shape.type === 'circular');
        const saved = (store.calcState(item.id) || {}).choices || {};
        const st = {
            variant: variants.some(v => v.id === saved.variant) ? saved.variant : (variants[0] ? variants[0].id : ''),
            view: twoViews && (saved.view === 'plug' || saved.view === 'socket') ? saved.view : (shape.drawn === 'socket' ? 'socket' : 'plug'),
            selected: '', hover: '', query: ''
        };
        let copyTimer = 0;
        const pinsNow = () => {
            if (!variants.length) return Array.isArray(item.pins) ? item.pins : [];
            return (variants.find(v => v.id === st.variant) || variants[0]).pins || [];
        };
        const favoriteLabel = () => (store.isFavorite(item.id) ? t('desktop.ecalc_favorite_remove') : t('desktop.ecalc_favorite_add'));
        const paragraphs = text => String(text || '').split(/\n{2,}/).filter(part => part.trim()).map(part => '<p>' + esc(part.trim()) + '</p>').join('');
        const swatch = (type) => {
            const info = typeInfo.get(type) || {};
            return '<svg class="ec-pin-swatch" data-type="' + esc(type) + '" viewBox="0 0 12 12" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><rect x="1" y="1" width="10" height="10" rx="2.5" fill="' + esc(Draw.safeColor(info.hex) || '#9e9e9e') + '"/></svg>';
        };
        const wireSwatch = id => {
            const info = wireInfo.get(id) || {}, base = Draw.safeColor(info.hex), stripe = Draw.safeColor(info.stripe);
            if (!base) return '';
            return '<svg class="ec-wire-swatch" data-wire="' + esc(id) + '" viewBox="0 0 24 10" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><rect class="ec-wire-base" x="1" y="1" width="22" height="8" rx="3" fill="' + base + '"/>'
                + (stripe ? '<rect class="ec-wire-stripe" x="1" y="4" width="22" height="2.4" fill="' + stripe + '"/>' : '') + '</svg>';
        };

        // ---- markup --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        const el = document.createElement('article');
        el.className = 'ec-page ec-pinout-page';
        el.dataset.pinout = item.id;
        el.dataset.narrow = 'false';
        el.tabIndex = -1;
        el.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', uid + '-title');
        const choice = (name, legend, entries, current, extra) => '<fieldset class="ec-choice" data-choice="' + name + '"><legend>' + esc(legend) + '</legend><div class="ec-seg">'
            + entries.map(entry => '<label><input type="radio" name="' + uid + '-' + name + '" value="' + esc(entry.value) + '"' + (entry.value === current ? ' checked' : '') + '><span>' + esc(entry.label) + '</span></label>').join('') + '</div>' + (extra || '') + '</fieldset>';
        const controls = (variants.length ? choice('variant', t('desktop.ecalc_pin_variant'), variants.map(v => ({ value: v.id, label: v.name })), st.variant) : '')
            + (twoViews ? choice('view', t('desktop.ecalc_pin_view'), [{ value: 'plug', label: item.views.plug }, { value: 'socket', label: item.views.socket }], st.view, '<span class="ec-pin-face">' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_face')) + '</span>') : '');
        el.innerHTML = '<header class="ec-page-head"><h2 class="ec-title" id="' + uid + '-title">' + esc(item.name) + '</h2><div class="ec-actions">'
            + '<button type="button" class="ec-btn" data-action="favorite" aria-pressed="false">' + icon('star') + '<span class="ec-btn-label" data-label="favorite"></span></button>'
            + '<button type="button" class="ec-btn" data-action="copy" title="' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_copy')) + '" aria-label="' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_copy')) + '">' + icon('copy') + '<span class="ec-btn-label" data-label="copy">' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_copy')) + '</span></button></div></header>'
            + (item.doc ? '<div class="ec-pin-doc">' + paragraphs(item.doc) + '</div>' : '')
            + (controls ? '<div class="ec-pin-controls">' + controls + '</div>' : '')
            + '<div class="ec-pin-main"><section class="ec-stage ec-pin-stage"><div class="ec-pin-art-host"></div><ul class="ec-pin-legend" aria-label="' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_legend')) + '"></ul>'
            + '<div class="ec-pin-detail" aria-live="polite"></div></section>'
            + '<section class="ec-table-wrap ec-pin-tablewrap"><div class="ec-table-bar"><label class="ec-filter">' + icon('search')
            + '<input class="ec-filter-input" type="search" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" maxlength="64" placeholder="' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_filter')) + '" aria-label="' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_filter')) + '"><kbd class="ec-kbd">/</kbd></label>'
            + '<span class="ec-table-count" role="status" aria-live="polite"></span></div>'
            + '<div class="ec-table-scroll ec-pin-scroll" role="region" tabindex="0" aria-label="' + esc(item.name) + '"><table class="ec-table ec-pin-table"><caption class="ec-sr">' + esc(item.name) + '</caption><thead></thead><tbody></tbody></table></div></section></div>'
            + (item.notes ? '<section class="ec-table-notes ec-pin-notes"><h3>' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_table_notes')) + '</h3>' + paragraphs(item.notes) + '</section>' : '')
            + '<p class="ec-source"><strong>' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_source')) + ':</strong> ' + esc(item.source || '') + '</p>';

        const hostEl = el.querySelector('.ec-pin-art-host'), legendEl = el.querySelector('.ec-pin-legend'), detailEl = el.querySelector('.ec-pin-detail');
        const filterEl = el.querySelector('.ec-filter-input'), countEl = el.querySelector('.ec-table-count');
        const scrollEl = el.querySelector('.ec-pin-scroll'), headEl = el.querySelector('thead'), bodyEl = el.querySelector('tbody');

        // ---- filter, rows ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        const hasWire = () => pinsNow().some(pin => pin.wire);
        const haystack = pin => [pin.number, pin.name, pin.function, typeName(pin.type), pin.wire ? wireName(pin.wire) : '', pin.notes].join('\n').toLowerCase();
        const visiblePins = () => {
            const needle = st.query.trim().toLowerCase();
            return pinsNow().filter(pin => !needle || haystack(pin).includes(needle));
        };

        function renderTable() {
            const wires = hasWire();
            el.dataset.hasWire = wires ? 'true' : 'false';
            headEl.innerHTML = '<tr><th scope="col">' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_number')) + '</th><th scope="col">' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_name')) + '</th><th scope="col">' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_function')) + '</th>'
                + '<th scope="col">' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_type')) + '</th>' + (wires ? '<th scope="col">' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_wire')) + '</th>' : '') + '<th scope="col">' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_notes')) + '</th></tr>';
            const shown = visiblePins();
            bodyEl.innerHTML = shown.length ? shown.map(pin => '<tr data-pin="' + esc(pin.number) + '" data-type="' + esc(pin.type) + '"><th scope="row"><button type="button" class="ec-pin-rowbtn" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_select', { number: pin.number })) + '">' + esc(pin.number) + '</button></th>'
                + '<td class="ec-pin-cell-name">' + esc(pin.name) + '</td><td>' + esc(pin.function) + '</td>'
                + '<td><span class="ec-pin-chip" data-type="' + esc(pin.type) + '">' + swatch(pin.type) + '<span>' + esc(typeName(pin.type)) + '</span></span></td>'
                + (wires ? '<td>' + (pin.wire ? '<span class="ec-pin-wire">' + wireSwatch(pin.wire) + '<span>' + esc(wireName(pin.wire)) + '</span></span>' : '') + '</td>' : '')
                + '<td class="ec-pin-cell-notes">' + esc(pin.notes || '') + '</td></tr>').join('')
                : '<tr class="ec-table-empty"><td colspan="' + (wires ? 6 : 5) + '">' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_no_match')) + '</td></tr>';
            const total = pinsNow().length;
            countEl.textContent = st.query.trim() ? t('desktop.ecalc_pin_rows_filtered', { shown: shown.length, total }) : t('desktop.ecalc_pin_rows', { total });
        }

        function renderLegend() {
            const used = [...new Set(pinsNow().map(pin => pin.type))];
            const order = (options.pinTypes || []).map(type => type.id);
            used.sort((a, b) => (order.indexOf(a) + 1 || 99) - (order.indexOf(b) + 1 || 99));
            legendEl.innerHTML = used.map(type => '<li class="ec-pin-legend-item" data-type="' + esc(type) + '">' + swatch(type) + '<span>' + esc(typeName(type)) + '</span></li>').join('');
        }

        function renderDrawing() {
            const pins = pinsNow();
            const view = Draw.layout(shape, pins, { view: st.view });
            const types = {}, wires = {};
            for (const [id, info] of typeInfo) types[id] = { hex: info.hex, ink: info.ink };
            for (const [id, info] of wireInfo) wires[id] = { hex: info.hex, stripe: info.stripe };
            hostEl.innerHTML = Draw.svg({ layout: view, types, wires, label: t('desktop.ecalc_pin_drawing', { name: item.name, count: pins.length }) });
            fitDrawing();
            paintFilter();
            paintMarks();
        }
        function fitDrawing() {
            const art = hostEl.querySelector('svg.ec-pin-art');
            if (!art || !hostEl.clientWidth) return;
            const box = art.viewBox.baseVal, scale = Math.max(MIN_SCALE, Math.min((hostEl.clientWidth - 8) / box.width, MAX_SCALE, Math.max(1, TALL / box.height)));
            art.setAttribute('width', String(Math.round(box.width * scale)));
            art.setAttribute('height', String(Math.round(box.height * scale)));
        }

        function renderDetail() {
            const pin = pinsNow().find(entry => entry.number === st.selected);
            if (!pin) { detailEl.innerHTML = '<p class="ec-pin-hint">' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_pick')) + '</p>'; return; }
            detailEl.innerHTML = '<div class="ec-pin-detail-head" data-type="' + esc(pin.type) + '"><span class="ec-pin-detail-num">' + esc(pin.number) + '</span><strong class="ec-pin-detail-name">' + esc(pin.name) + '</strong></div>'
                + '<dl class="ec-pin-detail-rows"><dt>' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_function')) + '</dt><dd>' + esc(pin.function) + '</dd>'
                + '<dt>' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_type')) + '</dt><dd><span class="ec-pin-chip" data-type="' + esc(pin.type) + '">' + swatch(pin.type) + '<span>' + esc(typeName(pin.type)) + '</span></span></dd>'
                + (pin.wire ? '<dt>' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_wire')) + '</dt><dd><span class="ec-pin-wire">' + wireSwatch(pin.wire) + '<span>' + esc(wireName(pin.wire)) + '</span></span></dd>' : '')
                + (pin.notes ? '<dt>' + esc(t('desktop.ecalc_pin_notes')) + '</dt><dd>' + esc(pin.notes) + '</dd>' : '') + '</dl>';
        }

        // ---- highlight ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        const pinGroups = () => el.querySelectorAll('g.ec-pin');
        function paintMarks() {
            for (const group of pinGroups()) {
                const number = group.getAttribute('data-pin');
                group.dataset.selected = number === st.selected ? 'true' : 'false';
                group.dataset.hover = number === st.hover ? 'true' : 'false';
            }
            for (const row of bodyEl.querySelectorAll('tr[data-pin]')) {
                const number = row.dataset.pin;
                row.dataset.selected = number === st.selected ? 'true' : 'false';
                row.dataset.hover = number === st.hover ? 'true' : 'false';
                row.querySelector('.ec-pin-rowbtn').setAttribute('aria-pressed', number === st.selected ? 'true' : 'false');
            }
        }
        function paintFilter() {
            const needle = st.query.trim().toLowerCase();
            const hit = new Set(visiblePins().map(pin => pin.number));
            for (const group of pinGroups()) group.dataset.dim = needle && !hit.has(group.getAttribute('data-pin')) ? 'true' : 'false';
        }
        // Puts the row in the middle of the table area when it is not visible there; only the area scrolls.
        function revealRow(row) {
            const area = scrollEl.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (!area.height || scrollEl.scrollHeight <= scrollEl.clientHeight) return;
            const head = headEl.getBoundingClientRect().height, box = row.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (box.top >= area.top + head && box.bottom <= area.bottom) return;
            scrollEl.scrollTop += (box.top - area.top) - Math.max(head, (area.height - box.height) / 2);
        }
        function select(number) {
            st.selected = st.selected === number ? '' : number;
            paintMarks();
            renderDetail();
            const row = st.selected ? bodyEl.querySelector('tr[data-pin="' + CSS.escape(st.selected) + '"]') : null;
            if (row) revealRow(row);
        }
        function hover(number) {
            if (st.hover === number) return;
            st.hover = number;
            paintMarks();
        }

        // ---- copy ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        function plainText() {
            const wires = hasWire();
            const head = [t('desktop.ecalc_pin_number'), t('desktop.ecalc_pin_name'), t('desktop.ecalc_pin_function'), t('desktop.ecalc_pin_type')].concat(wires ? [t('desktop.ecalc_pin_wire')] : [], [t('desktop.ecalc_pin_notes')]);
            const rows = visiblePins().map(pin => [pin.number, pin.name, pin.function, typeName(pin.type)].concat(wires ? [pin.wire ? wireName(pin.wire) : ''] : [], [pin.notes || '']));
            return [head].concat(rows).map(row => row.map(oneLine).join('\t')).join('\n');
        }

        function paintActions() {
            const button = el.querySelector('[data-action="favorite"]'), on = store.isFavorite(item.id);
            button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
            button.querySelector('[data-label]').textContent = favoriteLabel();
            button.title = favoriteLabel();
            button.setAttribute('aria-label', favoriteLabel());
        }
        function persist() { store.saveCalc(item.id, { choices: { variant: st.variant, view: st.view } }); }
        function renderAll() {
            renderLegend();
            renderTable();
            renderDrawing();
            if (st.selected && !pinsNow().some(pin => pin.number === st.selected)) st.selected = '';
            paintMarks();
            renderDetail();
        }

        // ---- events ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        el.addEventListener('pointerover', event => {
            const target = event.target.closest ? event.target.closest('g.ec-pin, tr[data-pin]') : null;
            hover(target && el.contains(target) ? (target.getAttribute('data-pin') || '') : '');
        });
        el.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => hover(''));
        el.addEventListener('change', event => {
            const input = event.target;
            if (!input || input.type !== 'radio') return;
            if (input.name === uid + '-variant') st.variant = input.value;
            else if (input.name === uid + '-view') st.view = input.value;
            else return;
            persist();
            if (input.name === uid + '-variant') renderAll(); else renderDrawing();
        });
        filterEl.addEventListener('input', () => {
            st.query = filterEl.value;
            renderTable();
            paintFilter();
            paintMarks();
        });
        filterEl.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
            if (event.key === 'Escape' && filterEl.value) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
                filterEl.value = '';
                st.query = '';
                renderTable();
                paintFilter();
                paintMarks();
            }
        });
        el.addEventListener('click', event => {
            const pinTarget = event.target.closest('g.ec-pin, tr[data-pin]');
            if (pinTarget && el.contains(pinTarget)) { select(pinTarget.getAttribute('data-pin')); return; }
            const button = event.target.closest('[data-action]');
            if (!button || !el.contains(button)) return;
            if (button.dataset.action === 'favorite') {
                store.toggleFavorite(item.id);
                paintActions();
                if (options.onFavorite) options.onFavorite(item.id);
            } else if (button.dataset.action === 'copy') {
                window.ECalcCalcPage.copyText(plainText());
                const label = button.querySelector('[data-label]');
                button.dataset.done = 'true';
                label.textContent = t('desktop.ecalc_copied');
                button.title = t('desktop.ecalc_copied');
                clearTimeout(copyTimer);
                copyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    delete button.dataset.done;
                    label.textContent = t('desktop.ecalc_pin_copy');
                    button.title = t('desktop.ecalc_pin_copy');
                }, COPIED_MS);
            }
        });

        renderAll();
        paintActions();

        return {
            el,
            // The shell calls this whenever the page host changes its size and once the page is attached.
            layout() {
                const width = el.clientWidth;
                if (!width) return;
                el.dataset.narrow = width < NARROW_BELOW ? 'true' : 'false';
                fitDrawing();
            },
            refresh() { paintActions(); },
            focusFilter() {
                filterEl.focus();
                filterEl.select();
            },
            dispose() {
                clearTimeout(copyTimer);
                store.flush();
            }
        };
    }

    window.ECalcPinoutPage = { create };
})();
```

```css
/* pinouts */
/* The pinout pages: the connector drawing of ecalc-pinout-draw.js and the pin table. The fill of a contact and the ink of its
   number are attributes of the drawing (the hex and ink of the pin type in the catalog data, a red power pin is red in every
   desktop skin); the shells, the leaders, the names and the numbers outside a contact take tokens. */
.ec-pinout-page { max-width: 1280px; overflow-anchor: none; }
.ec-pinout-page :is(.ec-pin-doc, .ec-pin-notes, .ec-source, .ec-pin-detail) { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.ec-pin-doc { max-width: 78ch; color: var(--vd-theme-muted); }
.ec-pin-doc p { margin: 0 0 6px; }
.ec-pin-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 24px; min-width: 0; }
.ec-pin-controls .ec-choice { max-width: 100%; }
.ec-pin-face { color: var(--vd-theme-muted); font-size: 12.5px; }
.ec-pin-main { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 14px; align-items: start; min-width: 0; }
.ec-pinout-page[data-narrow="false"] .ec-pin-main { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(0, 1fr); }
.ec-app[data-compact="true"] .ec-pinout-page .ec-pin-main { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
.ec-pin-stage { justify-items: stretch; }
.ec-pin-art-host { display: grid; justify-items: start; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 0; overflow-x: auto; }
.ec-pin-art { display: block; flex: none; margin-inline: auto; overflow: visible; color: var(--vd-text); }
.ec-shell { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vd-text) 7%, transparent); stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.ec-shell-flange { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vd-text) 4%, transparent); stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.ec-shell-tongue { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vd-text) 14%, transparent); stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vd-text) 50%, transparent); stroke-width: 1; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.ec-shell-hole { fill: var(--ec-stage-bg); stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-width: 1.2; }
.ec-shell-latch, .ec-shell-key, .ec-shell-conn, .ec-shell-tab, .ec-shell-insulator { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vd-text) 22%, transparent); stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.ec-shell-lead { fill: none; stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round; opacity: .7; }
.ec-pin { cursor: pointer; outline: none; }
.ec-pin-hit { fill: transparent; }
.ec-pin-body { stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-width: 1.2; }
.ec-pin[data-type="nc"] .ec-pin-body { stroke-dasharray: 3 2; }
.ec-pin-ring { fill: none; stroke: transparent; stroke-width: 2.5; pointer-events: none; }
.ec-pin[data-hover="true"] .ec-pin-ring { stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ds-color-border-focus) 60%, transparent); }
.ec-pin[data-selected="true"] .ec-pin-ring { stroke: var(--ds-color-border-focus); stroke-width: 3; }
.ec-pin[data-dim="true"] { opacity: .2; }
.ec-pin-num { font-family: var(--ec-mono); font-weight: 700; pointer-events: none; }
.ec-pin-num-out { fill: var(--vd-text); }
.ec-pin-name { fill: var(--vd-text); font-family: var(--vd-font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif); }
.ec-pin-mark { fill: var(--vd-text); pointer-events: none; }
.ec-leader { fill: none; stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-width: 1; opacity: .45; pointer-events: none; }
.ec-pin-inner-label { fill: var(--vd-theme-muted); font-family: var(--vd-font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; }
.ec-wire-base { stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-width: .8; }
.ec-pin-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 16px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-size: 12.5px; }
.ec-pin-legend-item, .ec-pin-chip, .ec-pin-wire { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.ec-pin-swatch { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.ec-pin-swatch rect { stroke: var(--vd-text); stroke-width: 1; }
.ec-pin-swatch[data-type="nc"] rect { stroke-dasharray: 2 1.5; }
.ec-wire-swatch { width: 24px; height: 10px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.ec-pin-detail { min-height: 104px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--ec-line); border-radius: var(--vd-mat-card-radius, var(--ds-radius-md)); background: var(--vd-mat-card, var(--vd-theme-panel-bg)); }
.ec-pin-hint { margin: 0; color: var(--vd-theme-muted); }
.ec-pin-detail-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.ec-pin-detail-num { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 28px; height: 24px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--vd-text); border-radius: var(--ds-radius-xs, 4px); font: 700 13px var(--ec-mono); }
.ec-pin-detail-rows { display: grid; grid-template-columns: max-content minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 2px 12px; margin: 0; }
.ec-pin-detail-rows dt { color: var(--vd-mat-label-color, var(--vd-theme-muted)); font-weight: 600; }
.ec-pin-detail-rows dd { min-width: 0; margin: 0; }
.ec-pin-tablewrap { min-width: 0; }
.ec-pin-scroll { max-height: min(560px, 70vh); }
.ec-app .ec-table.ec-pin-table { width: 100%; table-layout: auto; }
.ec-app .ec-table.ec-pin-table :is(th, td) { min-width: 0; max-width: none; padding: 5px 8px; vertical-align: top; white-space: normal; overflow-wrap: break-word; }
.ec-app .ec-table.ec-pin-table .ec-pin-cell-notes { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.ec-app .ec-table.ec-pin-table thead th { vertical-align: bottom; }
.ec-pin-table .ec-pin-cell-name { font-family: var(--ec-mono); font-size: 13px; }
.ec-pin-table tbody tr[data-hover="true"] > * { background: var(--vd-mat-hover, var(--vd-theme-control-hover)); }
.ec-pin-table tbody tr[data-selected="true"] > * { background: var(--vd-mat-selected, var(--vd-theme-accent-soft)); color: var(--vd-mat-selected-text, inherit); }
.ec-pin-table tbody tr[data-selected="true"] > :first-child { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--vd-accent); }
.ec-pin-rowbtn { min-width: 30px; height: 24px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--vd-mat-btn-border, var(--vd-theme-border)); border-radius: var(--ds-radius-xs, 4px); background: var(--vd-mat-btn, var(--vd-theme-control-bg)); color: var(--vd-mat-btn-text, inherit); font: 700 12px var(--ec-mono); cursor: pointer; }
.ec-pin-rowbtn:hover { background: var(--vd-mat-btn-hover, var(--vd-theme-control-hover)); }
.ec-pin-rowbtn[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--vd-mat-selected-color, var(--vd-theme-accent-border)); background: var(--vd-mat-selected, var(--vd-theme-accent-soft)); color: var(--vd-mat-selected-text, inherit); }
@media (pointer: coarse) { .ec-pin-rowbtn { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
    body:not([data-animations="false"]) .ec-pin-ring { transition: stroke .1s ease; }
    body:not([data-animations="false"]) .ec-pin { transition: opacity .12s ease; }
}
/* end of pinouts */
```

```python
for lang in L:
    path = f'{root}/ui/lang/desktop/{lang}.json'
    raw = open(path, encoding='utf-8', newline='').read()
    data = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=collections.OrderedDict)
    keys = list(data)
    assert json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + chr(10) == raw or json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) == raw, lang + ' does not round-trip'
    idx = [i for i, key in enumerate(keys) if key.startswith('desktop.ecalc_')]
    assert idx == list(range(idx[0], idx[-1] + 1)), lang + ' ecalc block is not contiguous'
    block = keys[idx[0]:idx[-1] + 1]
    assert block == sorted(block), lang + ' ecalc block is not sorted'
    for key, values in K.items():
        data[key] = values[lang]
    newblock = sorted(block + [k for k in K if k not in block])
    order = keys[:idx[0]] + newblock + keys[idx[-1] + 1:]
    out = collections.OrderedDict((k, data[k]) for k in order)
    text = json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + (chr(10) if raw.endswith(chr(10)) else '')
    open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='').write(text)
print('ok', len(K))
```

### Task UP3: the browser tests

**Files:** create `ui/desktop_ecalc_pinouts_browser_test.go`.

- [ ] **Step 1: write the tests.** Create the file (run `gofmt -w`). `pinoutReportJS` is the geometry check of the real browser: every pin of the shown variant is drawn exactly once and has a row, the contacts do not overlap, a number inside a contact lies inside it (a round contact: its four corners inside the circle), an outside number or a name overlaps no contact and no other text and lies inside the drawing, no text is mirrored (the determinant of its screen matrix is positive), the host and the document do not scroll sideways, and the table stands under the drawing in a narrow window. `check` runs it for every variant and view of a pinout.


`ui/desktop_ecalc_pinouts_browser_test.go`:
```go
package ui

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/go-rod/rod/lib/input"
)

// ecalcPinoutFixturePatch adds the fixture pinouts of scripts/ecalc-pinout-fixtures.js (the text the node test evaluates, too)
// to the served catalog, in the JSON shape of the contract: every outline of rows, the shapes circular, dip, to, jack and board,
// dense connectors (USB-C with 24 contacts, HDMI with 19, a 2 x 20 header, a 38-pin board, DIP-28), variants, wires and long
// texts. The pinouts of the real catalog are taken out of the served JSON unless window.ecalcWithReal is set (then only they
// are served), so that the fixture assertions do not depend on content; their ids stay in window.ecalcRealPinoutIDs.
func ecalcPinoutFixturePatch(t testing.TB) string {
	t.Helper()
	source, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("..", "scripts", "ecalc-pinout-fixtures.js"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return `j => {
	const real = j.items.filter(item => item.kind === 'pinout');
	window.ecalcRealPinoutIDs = real.map(item => item.id);
	if (!window.ecalcWithReal) {
		j.items = j.items.filter(item => !real.includes(item));
		const fixtures = (` + string(source) + `)();
		window.ecalcFixtureIDs = fixtures.map(item => item.id);
		j.items.push(...fixtures);
	}
	return j;
}`
}

// pinoutReportJS examines the open pinout page and returns a JSON report. It is the geometry check of the real browser: every pin
// of the shown variant is drawn exactly once and has a table row, the fill of a contact is the hex of its pin type, a number
// written inside a contact lies inside it (a round contact: its corners inside the circle), a name or a number outside a contact
// overlaps no contact and no other text, no contact overlaps another, everything lies inside the svg, no text is mirrored
// (the determinant of its screen matrix is positive), and neither the page host nor the document scrolls sideways.
const pinoutReportJS = `()=>{
	const p=document.querySelector('.ec-pinout-page');
	if(!p)return 'null';
	const svg=p.querySelector('svg.ec-pin-art'),problems=[];
	const rect=el=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();return {l:r.left,t:r.top,r:r.right,b:r.bottom,w:r.width,h:r.height};};
	const overlap=(a,b,tol)=>Math.min(a.r,b.r)-Math.max(a.l,b.l)>tol&&Math.min(a.b,b.b)-Math.max(a.t,b.t)>tol;
	const within=(a,b,tol)=>a.l>=b.l-tol&&a.r<=b.r+tol&&a.t>=b.t-tol&&a.b<=b.b+tol;
	const out={id:p.dataset.pinout,view:svg?svg.dataset.view:'',shape:svg?svg.dataset.shape:'',problems};
	const rows=[...p.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[data-pin]')].map(tr=>tr.dataset.pin);
	out.rows=rows;
	if(!svg){problems.push('no drawing');return JSON.stringify(out);}
	const box=rect(svg),vb=svg.viewBox.baseVal;
	out.width=box.w;out.height=box.h;out.scale=box.w/vb.width;
	if(!(box.w>20&&box.h>20))problems.push('the drawing has no size');
	const groups=[...svg.querySelectorAll('g.ec-pin')];
	const numbers=groups.map(g=>g.getAttribute('data-pin'));
	out.pins=numbers;
	if(new Set(numbers).size!==numbers.length)problems.push('a pin is drawn twice');
	const bodies=groups.map(g=>({g,n:g.getAttribute('data-pin'),el:g.querySelector('.ec-pin-body')}));
	bodies.forEach(b=>{b.r=rect(b.el);});
	bodies.forEach(b=>{if(!within(b.r,box,1))problems.push('contact '+b.n+' lies outside the drawing');});
	for(let i=0;i<bodies.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<bodies.length;j++)if(overlap(bodies[i].r,bodies[j].r,1))problems.push('contacts '+bodies[i].n+' and '+bodies[j].n+' overlap');
	const texts=[];
	let minPx=1e9;
	for(const b of bodies){
		const num=b.g.querySelector('.ec-pin-num'),name=b.g.querySelector('.ec-pin-name');
		const fs=parseFloat(num.getAttribute('font-size'));minPx=Math.min(minPx,fs*out.scale);
		const nr=rect(num);
		if(b.g.dataset.num==='in'){
			const tol=1;
			if(b.el.tagName==='circle'){
				const cx=(b.r.l+b.r.r)/2,cy=(b.r.t+b.r.b)/2,rad=b.r.w/2+tol;
				const corners=[[nr.l,nr.t],[nr.r,nr.t],[nr.l,nr.b],[nr.r,nr.b]];
				if(corners.some(c=>Math.hypot(c[0]-cx,c[1]-cy)>rad))problems.push('the number of contact '+b.n+' sticks out of its circle');
			}else if(!within(nr,b.r,tol))problems.push('the number of contact '+b.n+' sticks out of its contact ('+nr.w.toFixed(1)+'x'+nr.h.toFixed(1)+' in '+b.r.w.toFixed(1)+'x'+b.r.h.toFixed(1)+')');
			if(getComputedStyle(num).fill===getComputedStyle(b.el).fill)problems.push('the number of contact '+b.n+' has the colour of its contact');
		}else{
			if(bodies.some(o=>overlap(nr,o.r,0.5)))problems.push('the outside number of contact '+b.n+' overlaps a contact');
			if(!within(nr,box,1))problems.push('the outside number of contact '+b.n+' lies outside the drawing');
			texts.push({n:b.n,kind:'number',r:nr});
		}
		if(name){
			const r=rect(name);minPx=Math.min(minPx,parseFloat(name.getAttribute('font-size'))*out.scale);
			if(bodies.some(o=>overlap(r,o.r,0.5)))problems.push('the name of pin '+b.n+' overlaps a contact');
			if(!within(r,box,1))problems.push('the name of pin '+b.n+' lies outside the drawing');
			texts.push({n:b.n,kind:'name',r});
		}
	}
	for(const t of svg.querySelectorAll('text')){
		const m=t.getScreenCTM();
		if(m&&m.a*m.d-m.b*m.c<=0)problems.push('a text is mirrored: '+t.textContent);
	}
	for(let i=0;i<texts.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<texts.length;j++)if(overlap(texts[i].r,texts[j].r,0.5))problems.push(texts[i].kind+' of pin '+texts[i].n+' overlaps '+texts[j].kind+' of pin '+texts[j].n);
	const labels=[...svg.querySelectorAll('.ec-pin-inner-label')].map(rect);
	for(const l of labels){if(bodies.some(o=>overlap(l,o.r,0.5)))problems.push('an inner label overlaps a contact');}
	out.minPx=Math.round(minPx*10)/10;
	const host=document.querySelector('.ec-page-host');
	out.sideways=host.scrollWidth>host.clientWidth+1||document.documentElement.scrollWidth>document.documentElement.clientWidth+1;
	if(out.sideways)problems.push('the page scrolls sideways');
	const stage=rect(p.querySelector('.ec-pin-stage')),table=rect(p.querySelector('.ec-pin-tablewrap'));
	out.stacked=table.t>=stage.b-1;
	out.stage=stage.w;
	if(!within(rect(p.querySelector('.ec-pin-art-host')),stage,1))problems.push('the drawing host leaves the stage');
	return JSON.stringify(out);
}`

type pinoutReport struct {
	ID       string   `json:"id"`
	View     string   `json:"view"`
	Shape    string   `json:"shape"`
	Pins     []string `json:"pins"`
	Rows     []string `json:"rows"`
	Problems []string `json:"problems"`
	Width    float64  `json:"width"`
	Height   float64  `json:"height"`
	Scale    float64  `json:"scale"`
	MinPx    float64  `json:"minPx"`
	Sideways bool     `json:"sideways"`
	Stacked  bool     `json:"stacked"`
	Stage    float64  `json:"stage"`
}

// pinoutHarness drives the pinout pages of the real desktop shell.
type pinoutHarness struct {
	*ecalcBrowserFixture
}

func (h *pinoutHarness) report() pinoutReport {
	h.T.Helper()
	raw := h.Page.MustEval(pinoutReportJS).Str()
	if raw == "null" {
		h.T.Fatal("no pinout page is open")
	}
	var report pinoutReport
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &report); err != nil {
		h.T.Fatalf("pinout report %s: %v", raw, err)
	}
	return report
}

// open selects the pinouts on the rail and the item in the list (by script: the fixture window reaches under the taskbar).
func (h *pinoutHarness) open(id string) {
	h.T.Helper()
	h.Page.MustEval(`id=>{document.querySelector('.ec-rail-btn[data-rail="pinouts"]').click();document.querySelector('.ec-item[data-id="'+id+'"]').click();}`, id)
	h.Wait(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-pinout-page')?.dataset.pinout==='` + id + `' && !!document.querySelector('.ec-pinout-page svg.ec-pin-art')`)
	// the page measures its host after the next frames (the resize observer of the shell)
	h.Page.MustEval(`()=>new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>r(true))))`)
}

// check opens a pinout and reports the problems of its drawing in every variant and every view it offers.
func (h *pinoutHarness) check(id string, shotAs string) []pinoutReport {
	h.T.Helper()
	h.open(id)
	var reports []pinoutReport
	variants := h.Page.MustEval(`()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('.ec-pinout-page [data-choice="variant"] input')].map(i=>i.value)`).Arr()
	views := h.Page.MustEval(`()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('.ec-pinout-page [data-choice="view"] input')].map(i=>i.value)`).Arr()
	setChoice := func(kind, value string) {
		h.Page.MustEval(`(k,v)=>{const r=document.querySelector('.ec-pinout-page [data-choice="'+k+'"] input[value="'+v+'"]');r.checked=true;r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}`, kind, value)
	}
	run := func(label string) {
		report := h.report()
		if len(report.Problems) > 0 {
			h.Shot("pinout-problem-" + id + "-" + label)
			h.T.Errorf("pinout %s (%s): %s", id, label, strings.Join(report.Problems, "; "))
		}
		if len(report.Rows) != len(report.Pins) {
			h.T.Errorf("pinout %s (%s): %d table rows for %d drawn pins", id, label, len(report.Rows), len(report.Pins))
		}
		reports = append(reports, report)
	}
	for vi := 0; vi < max(1, len(variants)); vi++ {
		if len(variants) > 0 {
			setChoice("variant", variants[vi].Str())
		}
		for wi := 0; wi < max(1, len(views)); wi++ {
			label := "base"
			if len(views) > 0 {
				setChoice("view", views[wi].Str())
				label = views[wi].Str()
			}
			if len(variants) > 0 {
				label += "-" + variants[vi].Str()
			}
			run(label)
			if shotAs != "" {
				h.Shot(shotAs + "-" + id + "-" + label)
			}
		}
	}
	return reports
}

// TestDesktopECalcPinoutsBrowser drives the pinout pages inside the real desktop shell with fixture pinouts injected into the
// served catalog: the Pinouts list sectioned by group, the drawing of every fixture in every view and variant (geometry measured
// in the browser), the mirror image of the other view, the hover and click link between a contact and its row, the selected
// row scrolled into view inside the table, the filter, the copy, the variants and their persistence, the stacked layout of a
// phone-sized window and the real catalog have tests of their own. Set AURAGO_BROWSER_ARTIFACT_DIR to keep
// screenshots.
func TestDesktopECalcPinoutsBrowser(t *testing.T) {
	f := &pinoutHarness{newECalcBrowserFixture(t, ecalcPinoutFixturePatch(t))}
	page := f.Page
	words := f.Words
	same := func(label string, got, want any) {
		t.Helper()
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: got %v, want %v", label, got, want)
		}
	}
	eval := func(js string, args ...any) string {
		t.Helper()
		return page.MustEval(js, args...).Str()
	}

	// ---- the rail and the list: the Pinouts category with the sections in the order of the contract ----------------------------
	f.OpenApp(`.ec-page[data-calc]`)
	f.Wait(`()=>!!document.querySelector('.ec-rail-btn[data-rail="pinouts"]')`)
	ids := []string{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(eval(`()=>JSON.stringify(window.ecalcFixtureIDs)`)), &ids); err != nil || len(ids) < 30 {
		t.Fatalf("fixture ids: %v (%v)", ids, err)
	}
	same("the rail count", eval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-rail-btn[data-rail="pinouts"] .ec-count').textContent`), strconv.Itoa(len(ids)))
	page.MustEval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-rail-btn[data-rail="pinouts"]').click()`)
	same("the sections of the Pinouts list", eval(`()=>JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('.ec-group-title')].map(h=>h.textContent))`),
		`["`+strings.Join([]string{words["desktop.ecalc_group_data"], words["desktop.ecalc_group_audio"], words["desktop.ecalc_group_pc_power"], words["desktop.ecalc_group_boards"], words["desktop.ecalc_group_debug"], words["desktop.ecalc_group_ics"]}, `","`)+`"]`)

	// A page for every shape has its parts: the legend lists the types in use, the table the pins, the wire column only with wires.
	f.open("fx_pin_dsub")
	same("columns without wires", eval(`()=>document.querySelectorAll('.ec-pin-table thead th').length`), "5")
	same("legend of the types in use", eval(`()=>document.querySelectorAll('.ec-pin-legend-item').length`), "6")
	f.open("fx_pin_rj45")
	same("columns with wires", eval(`()=>document.querySelectorAll('.ec-pin-table thead th').length`), "6")
	same("a wire stub for every wire", eval(`()=>document.querySelectorAll('svg.ec-pin-art .ec-wire-stub').length`), "8")
	same("the striped wire has a stripe", eval(`()=>document.querySelectorAll('svg.ec-pin-art .ec-wire-stripe').length`), "4")

	// A single column keeps its wires on the left and its names on the right; a symbol is a safe pin number.
	f.open("fx_pin_servo")
	same("servo wires", eval(`()=>JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('svg.ec-pin-art .ec-wire-stub')].map(w=>{const r=w.querySelector('.ec-wire-base').getBBox();return r.width>r.height;}))`), "[true,true,true]")
	same("servo pins", eval(`()=>JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('g.ec-pin')].map(g=>g.getAttribute('data-pin')))`), `["S","+","-"]`)
	page.MustElement(`g.ec-pin[data-pin="+"] .ec-pin-body`).MustClick()
	same("a symbol pin is selected", eval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-pin-detail-num').textContent+document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-selected="true"]').length`), "+1")
	// Seven variants with long names wrap inside the page.
	f.open("fx_pin_many_variants")
	same("the variant selector wraps", eval(`()=>{const s=document.querySelector('[data-choice="variant"] .ec-seg'),h=document.querySelector('.ec-page-host');return (s.getBoundingClientRect().height>40)+'|'+(h.scrollWidth<=h.clientWidth+1);}`), "true|true")

	// ---- the other view is the mirror image: positions mirrored, text readable, the key at the same height -------------------
	for _, id := range []string{"fx_pin_dsub", "fx_pin_usb_c", "fx_pin_din5", "fx_pin_atx24", "fx_pin_sata_data", "fx_pin_rect"} {
		f.open(id)
		centers := `()=>{const s=document.querySelector('svg.ec-pin-art'),w=s.viewBox.baseVal.width;return JSON.stringify({w,view:s.dataset.view,flip:s.querySelector('.ec-pin-shell').getAttribute('transform')||'',c:Object.fromEntries([...s.querySelectorAll('g.ec-pin')].map(g=>{const b=g.querySelector('.ec-pin-body').getBBox(),n=g.querySelector('.ec-pin-num').getBBox();return [g.getAttribute('data-pin'),[b.x+b.width/2,b.y+b.height/2,n.x+n.width/2]];}))});}`
		var plug, socket struct {
			W    float64
			View string
			Flip string
			C    map[string][3]float64
		}
		f.Page.MustEval(`()=>{const r=document.querySelector('.ec-pinout-page [data-choice="view"] input[value="plug"]');r.checked=true;r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}`)
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(eval(centers)), &plug); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		f.Page.MustEval(`()=>{const r=document.querySelector('.ec-pinout-page [data-choice="view"] input[value="socket"]');r.checked=true;r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}`)
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(eval(centers)), &socket); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if plug.View != "plug" || socket.View != "socket" || len(plug.C) == 0 || len(plug.C) != len(socket.C) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: views %s/%s with %d/%d contacts", id, plug.View, socket.View, len(plug.C), len(socket.C))
		}
		drawn := plug
		other := socket
		if id == "fx_pin_xlr" {
			drawn, other = socket, plug
		}
		if drawn.Flip != "" || !strings.Contains(other.Flip, "scale(-1 1)") {
			t.Errorf("%s: the shell transform is %q in the drawn view and %q in the other", id, drawn.Flip, other.Flip)
		}
		for pin, a := range drawn.C {
			b := other.C[pin]
			if pinoutAbs(a[0]+b[0]-drawn.W) > 0.6 || pinoutAbs(a[1]-b[1]) > 0.01 || pinoutAbs(a[2]+b[2]-drawn.W) > 0.6 {
				t.Errorf("%s: pin %s at x %.1f / %.1f (number %.1f / %.1f) is not the mirror image about the axis of %.0f", id, pin, a[0], b[0], a[2], b[2], drawn.W)
			}
		}
	}
	// A shape with one view has no toggle.
	for _, id := range []string{"fx_pin_dip8", "fx_pin_to92", "fx_pin_trs", "fx_pin_board38"} {
		f.open(id)
		same(id+" has no view toggle", eval(`()=>document.querySelectorAll('.ec-pinout-page [data-choice="view"]').length`), "0")
	}

	// ---- hover and click link the contact and its row; the selected row scrolls inside the table, not the page -----------------
	f.open("fx_pin_dip28")
	linked := func(attr, pin string) bool {
		return page.MustEval(`(a,n)=>{const g=document.querySelector('g.ec-pin[data-pin="'+n+'"]'),r=document.querySelector('tr[data-pin="'+n+'"]');return g.dataset[a]==='true'&&r.dataset[a]==='true'&&document.querySelectorAll('g.ec-pin[data-'+a+'="true"]').length===1&&document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-'+a+'="true"]').length===1;}`, attr, pin).Bool()
	}
	page.MustElement(`g.ec-pin[data-pin="3"] .ec-pin-body`).MustHover()
	if !linked("hover", "3") {
		t.Fatal("hovering the contact of pin 3 must highlight its row and nothing else")
	}
	page.MustElement(`tr[data-pin="5"] .ec-pin-cell-name`).MustHover()
	if !linked("hover", "5") {
		t.Fatal("hovering the row of pin 5 must highlight its contact and nothing else")
	}
	page.MustElement(`g.ec-pin[data-pin="4"] .ec-pin-body`).MustClick()
	if !linked("selected", "4") {
		t.Fatal("clicking the contact of pin 4 must select its row")
	}
	same("the detail panel names the pin", eval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-pin-detail-num').textContent+'|'+document.querySelector('.ec-pin-detail-name').textContent`), "4|"+eval(`()=>document.querySelector('tr[data-pin="4"] .ec-pin-cell-name').textContent`))
	same("the detail panel is a polite live region", eval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-pin-detail').getAttribute('aria-live')`), "polite")
	// The keyboard path: the button in the first cell of a row.
	page.MustElement(`tr[data-pin="7"] .ec-pin-rowbtn`).MustFocus()
	page.Keyboard.MustType(input.Enter)
	if !linked("selected", "7") || eval(`()=>document.querySelector('tr[data-pin="7"] .ec-pin-rowbtn').getAttribute('aria-pressed')`) != "true" {
		t.Fatal("pressing Enter on the row button must select the pin")
	}
	page.MustElement(`tr[data-pin="7"] .ec-pin-rowbtn`).MustClick()
	same("a second click deselects", eval(`()=>document.querySelectorAll('[data-selected="true"]').length`), "0")
	// Selecting a pin far down the table from the drawing scrolls the table area and leaves the page where it is.
	page.MustEval(`()=>{document.querySelector('.ec-pin-scroll').scrollTop=0;}`)
	scrolled := eval(`()=>{const host=document.querySelector('.ec-page-host'),area=document.querySelector('.ec-pin-scroll'),before=host.scrollTop,y=window.scrollY;
		document.querySelector('g.ec-pin[data-pin="26"]').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true}));
		const row=document.querySelector('tr[data-pin="26"]').getBoundingClientRect(),box=area.getBoundingClientRect(),head=document.querySelector('.ec-pin-table thead').getBoundingClientRect().height;
		return JSON.stringify({hostMoved:host.scrollTop!==before||window.scrollY!==y,areaTop:area.scrollTop,visible:row.top>=box.top+head-1&&row.bottom<=box.bottom+1,scrollable:area.scrollHeight>area.clientHeight});}`)
	var sc struct {
		HostMoved, Visible, Scrollable bool
		AreaTop                        float64
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(scrolled), &sc); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !sc.Scrollable || sc.HostMoved || !sc.Visible || sc.AreaTop <= 0 {
		t.Fatalf("selecting pin 26: %s (the row must be visible inside the scrolled table area and the page must not move)", scrolled)
	}

	// ---- the filter: dims the other contacts, hides the other rows, "/" focuses it; the copy is the visible rows ---------------
	f.open("fx_pin_rj45")
	wireName := eval(`()=>{return document.querySelector('tr[data-pin="3"] .ec-pin-wire span').textContent;}`)
	page.MustEval(`()=>{window.copied='';window.ECalcCalcPage.copyText=text=>{window.copied=text;};}`)
	page.MustElement(`body`).MustClick()
	page.Keyboard.MustType(input.Slash)
	f.Wait(`()=>document.activeElement&&document.activeElement.classList.contains('ec-filter-input')`)
	typeFilter := func(text string) {
		t.Helper()
		el := page.MustElement(`.ec-pinout-page .ec-filter-input`)
		el.MustSelectAllText()
		if text == "" {
			el.MustType(input.Backspace)
		} else {
			el.MustInput(text)
		}
	}
	typeFilter("gnd")
	state := eval(`()=>JSON.stringify({rows:[...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[data-pin]')].map(r=>r.dataset.pin),dim:[...document.querySelectorAll('g.ec-pin[data-dim="true"]')].length,count:document.querySelector('.ec-table-count').textContent})`)
	same("filter by name", state, `{"rows":["2"],"dim":7,"count":"`+strings.NewReplacer("{shown}", "1", "{total}", "8").Replace(words["desktop.ecalc_pin_rows_filtered"])+`"}`)
	page.MustElement(`.ec-pinout-page [data-action="copy"]`).MustClick()
	copied := strings.Split(eval(`()=>window.copied`), "\n")
	if len(copied) != 2 || len(strings.Split(copied[0], "\t")) != 6 || strings.Split(copied[1], "\t")[0] != "2" || strings.Split(copied[0], "\t")[0] != words["desktop.ecalc_pin_number"] {
		t.Fatalf("the copy of the filtered pinout is %q", copied)
	}
	groundName := eval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-pin-legend-item[data-type="ground"] span').textContent`)
	typeFilter(groundName)
	same("filter by type name", eval(`()=>JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[data-pin]')].map(r=>r.dataset.type))`), `["ground","ground"]`)
	typeFilter(strings.ToLower(wireName))
	if got := page.MustEval(`()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[data-pin]')].every(r=>r.querySelector('.ec-pin-wire span').textContent.toLowerCase().includes(document.querySelector('.ec-filter-input').value.toLowerCase()))&&document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[data-pin]').length>0`).Bool(); !got {
		t.Fatal("filter by wire name must keep only rows with that wire")
	}
	typeFilter("zzzz-no-pin")
	same("no pin matches", eval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-table-empty td').textContent+'|'+document.querySelectorAll('g.ec-pin[data-dim="true"]').length`), words["desktop.ecalc_pin_no_match"]+"|8")
	typeFilter("")
	same("the filter is cleared", eval(`()=>document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr[data-pin]').length+'|'+document.querySelectorAll('g.ec-pin[data-dim="true"]').length`), "8|0")
	page.MustElement(`.ec-pinout-page [data-action="copy"]`).MustClick()
	if lines := strings.Split(eval(`()=>window.copied`), "\n"); len(lines) != 9 {
		t.Fatalf("the copy of the whole pinout has %d lines, want the header and 8 pins", len(lines))
	}

	// ---- variants: the selector switches names and wires and is remembered per item ----------------------------------------
	f.open("fx_pin_variants")
	same("variant A names", eval(`()=>document.querySelector('tr[data-pin="2"] .ec-pin-cell-name').textContent`), "GND")
	f.Page.MustEval(`()=>{const r=document.querySelector('[data-choice="variant"] input[value="vb"]');r.checked=true;r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}`)
	same("variant B names", eval(`()=>document.querySelector('tr[data-pin="2"] .ec-pin-cell-name').textContent+'|'+document.querySelector('g.ec-pin[data-pin="2"] .ec-pin-name')?.textContent`), "VGND|undefined")
	f.open("fx_pin_dsub")
	f.open("fx_pin_variants")
	same("the variant is remembered", eval(`()=>document.querySelector('[data-choice="variant"] input:checked').value+'|'+document.querySelector('tr[data-pin="2"] .ec-pin-cell-name').textContent`), "vb|VGND")
	f.open("fx_pin_dsub")
	f.Page.MustEval(`()=>{const r=document.querySelector('[data-choice="view"] input[value="socket"]');r.checked=true;r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}`)
	f.open("fx_pin_rj45")
	f.open("fx_pin_dsub")
	same("the view is remembered", eval(`()=>document.querySelector('[data-choice="view"] input:checked').value+'|'+document.querySelector('svg.ec-pin-art').dataset.view`), "socket|socket")
	same("the view captions and the fixed caption", eval(`()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-choice="view"] span')].map(s=>s.textContent).join('|')`),
		"Stecker (Stifte), Blick auf die Steckseite|Buchse (Kontakte), Blick auf die Steckseite|"+words["desktop.ecalc_pin_face"])

	// ---- long texts wrap: no sideways growth even in a narrow window; the favorite and the search keep working -------------------
	f.open("fx_pin_long")
	if r := f.report(); len(r.Problems) > 0 {
		t.Fatalf("fx_pin_long: %v", r.Problems)
	}
	page.MustElement(`.ec-pinout-page [data-action="favorite"]`).MustClick()
	same("favorite", eval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-pinout-page [data-action="favorite"]').getAttribute('aria-pressed')`), "true")
	page.MustElement(`.ec-pinout-page [data-action="favorite"]`).MustClick()
	f.Shot("pinout-long-wide")

	if errors := eval(`()=>JSON.stringify(fixtureErrors)`); errors != "[]" {
		t.Fatal(errors)
	}
}

func pinoutAbs(x float64) float64 {
	if x < 0 {
		return -x
	}
	return x
}

// startPinouts opens the app on the fixture catalog and returns the harness and the ids of the fixture pinouts.
func startPinouts(t *testing.T) (*pinoutHarness, []string) {
	t.Helper()
	f := &pinoutHarness{newECalcBrowserFixture(t, ecalcPinoutFixturePatch(t))}
	f.OpenApp(`.ec-page[data-calc]`)
	f.Wait(`()=>!!document.querySelector('.ec-rail-btn[data-rail="pinouts"]')`)
	ids := []string{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(f.Page.MustEval(`()=>JSON.stringify(window.ecalcFixtureIDs)`).Str()), &ids); err != nil || len(ids) < 30 {
		t.Fatalf("fixture ids: %v (%v)", ids, err)
	}
	return f, ids
}

// TestDesktopECalcPinoutDrawingsBrowser measures the drawing of every fixture pinout in every variant and view in the real
// browser (see pinoutReportJS) at the size of the desktop window.
func TestDesktopECalcPinoutDrawingsBrowser(t *testing.T) {
	f, ids := startPinouts(t)
	// ---- every fixture, in every variant and view: the geometry measured by the browser --------------------------------------
	dense := map[string]bool{"fx_pin_usb_c": true, "fx_pin_hdmi_a": true, "fx_pin_header40": true, "fx_pin_board38": true, "fx_pin_dip28": true}
	for _, id := range ids {
		for _, report := range f.check(id, "pinout") {
			t.Logf("%-22s %-14s %4.0fx%-4.0f scale %.2f smallest text %.1f px", id, report.View, report.Width, report.Height, report.Scale, report.MinPx)
			if report.MinPx < 7 && !dense[id] || report.MinPx < 6.5 {
				t.Errorf("pinout %s: the smallest text is %.1f px", id, report.MinPx)
			}
		}
	}
}

// TestDesktopECalcPinoutCompactBrowser opens every fixture pinout in a phone-sized window: the page stacks, nothing moves sideways.
func TestDesktopECalcPinoutCompactBrowser(t *testing.T) {
	f, ids := startPinouts(t)
	page := f.Page
	// ---- a phone-sized window: the page stacks, nothing moves sideways, every fixture still has a sound drawing -----------------
	f.CloseWindows()
	page.MustSetViewport(390, 667, 1, false)
	page.MustEval(`()=>fixtureTheme('fruity-dark')`)
	f.OpenApp(`.ec-app[data-compact="true"]`)
	f.Wait(`()=>!!document.querySelector('.ec-page')`)
	page.MustEval(`()=>document.querySelector('.ec-rail-btn[data-rail="pinouts"]').click()`)
	for _, id := range ids {
		for _, report := range f.check(id, "") {
			if !report.Stacked || report.Sideways {
				t.Errorf("compact %s (%s): stacked %v, sideways %v", id, report.View, report.Stacked, report.Sideways)
			}
			if report.MinPx < 6.5 {
				t.Errorf("compact %s (%s): the smallest text is %.1f px", id, report.View, report.MinPx)
			}
		}
	}
	f.open("fx_pin_usb_c")
	f.Shot("pinout-compact-usb-c")
	f.open("fx_pin_board38")
	f.Shot("pinout-compact-board38")
	f.open("fx_pin_long")
	f.Shot("pinout-compact-long")

	if errors := page.MustEval(`()=>JSON.stringify(fixtureErrors)`).Str(); errors != "[]" {
		t.Fatal(errors)
	}
}

// TestDesktopECalcPinoutRealBrowser opens every pinout of the real catalog (none until the content is assembled) and checks its
// drawing; it must pass with zero items as well.
func TestDesktopECalcPinoutRealBrowser(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := startPinouts(t)
	page := f.Page
	eval := func(js string) string { return page.MustEval(js).Str() }
	f.CloseWindows()
	// ---- the pinouts of the real catalog (none until the content is assembled): each one opens and draws soundly ---------------
	page.MustEval(`()=>{window.ecalcWithReal=true;fixtureTheme('standard');}`)
	f.OpenApp(`.ec-page`)
	realIDs := []string{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(eval(`()=>JSON.stringify(window.ecalcRealPinoutIDs)`)), &realIDs); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(realIDs) != len(f.Catalog.Pinouts) {
		t.Fatalf("the served catalog holds %d pinouts, the engine %d", len(realIDs), len(f.Catalog.Pinouts))
	}
	for _, p := range f.Catalog.Pinouts {
		if !slices.Contains(realIDs, p.ID) {
			t.Fatalf("the pinout %s is missing from the served catalog", p.ID)
		}
		reports := f.check(p.ID, "real")
		pins, _, _ := p.PinsOf("")
		if len(reports) == 0 || len(reports[0].Pins) != len(pins) {
			t.Fatalf("real pinout %s draws %d pins for %d pins", p.ID, len(reports[0].Pins), len(pins))
		}
	}

	if errors := eval(`()=>JSON.stringify(fixtureErrors)`); errors != "[]" {
		t.Fatal(errors)
	}
}

// pinoutContrastJS measures the drawing of the open pinout page against its stage in the current desktop skin: the fill of every
// contact must be the hex of its pin type (computed style), the outline of the shell, the names and the numbers outside the
// contacts are measured against what lies behind the stage (translucent layers are laid over the next one outward, an image falls
// back to the strong panel colour of the skin, like the code pages do).
const pinoutContrastJS = `()=>{
	const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=cv.height=1;const cx=cv.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
	const rgba=css=>{cx.clearRect(0,0,1,1);cx.fillStyle='#000';cx.fillStyle=css;cx.fillRect(0,0,1,1);const d=cx.getImageData(0,0,1,1).data;return [d[0],d[1],d[2],d[3]/255];};
	const over=(top,under)=>{const a=top[3];return [0,1,2].map(i=>top[i]*a+under[i]*(1-a)).concat([1]);};
	const lum=c=>{const f=v=>{v/=255;return v<=0.03928?v/12.92:Math.pow((v+0.055)/1.055,2.4);};return 0.2126*f(c[0])+0.7152*f(c[1])+0.0722*f(c[2]);};
	const ratio=(a,b)=>{const x=lum(a),y=lum(b);return (Math.max(x,y)+0.05)/(Math.min(x,y)+0.05);};
	const stage=document.querySelector('.ec-pin-stage');
	const strong=over(rgba(getComputedStyle(stage).getPropertyValue('--vd-theme-panel-bg-strong')||'#fff'),[255,255,255,1]);
	const behind=el=>{const layers=[];for(let n=el;n;n=n.parentElement){const cs=getComputedStyle(n);if(cs.backgroundImage&&cs.backgroundImage!=='none')return strong;const c=rgba(cs.backgroundColor);if(c[3]>0)layers.push(c);if(c[3]>=1)break;}
		let base=strong;if(layers.length&&layers[layers.length-1][3]>=1)base=layers.pop();for(let i=layers.length-1;i>=0;i--)base=over(layers[i],base);return base;};
	const bg=behind(stage),out={bg:bg.map(Math.round).join(',')};
	const svg=stage.querySelector('svg.ec-pin-art'),box=svg.getBoundingClientRect();
	out.size=box.width>20&&box.height>20;
	out.fills=[...svg.querySelectorAll('g.ec-pin')].map(g=>g.getAttribute('data-type')+'='+getComputedStyle(g.querySelector('.ec-pin-body')).fill).join('|');
	const stroke=(el)=>{const cs=getComputedStyle(el),c=rgba(cs.stroke);c[3]*=parseFloat(cs.strokeOpacity);return ratio(over(c,bg),bg);};
	out.shell=stroke(svg.querySelector('.ec-shell'));
	out.body=Math.min(...[...svg.querySelectorAll('g.ec-pin')].map(g=>ratio(rgba(getComputedStyle(g.querySelector('.ec-pin-body')).stroke),bg)));
	const names=[...svg.querySelectorAll('.ec-pin-name,.ec-pin-num-out')];
	out.names=names.length?Math.min(...names.map(n=>ratio(over(rgba(getComputedStyle(n).fill),bg),bg))):99;
	out.inks=[...svg.querySelectorAll('g.ec-pin[data-num="in"]')].map(g=>ratio(rgba(getComputedStyle(g.querySelector('.ec-pin-num')).fill),rgba(getComputedStyle(g.querySelector('.ec-pin-body')).fill))).reduce((m,v)=>Math.min(m,v),99);
	return JSON.stringify(out);
}`

// TestDesktopECalcPinoutSkinsBrowser checks the drawing in every desktop skin: it has a size, the contacts have the colour of
// their pin type in every skin (it comes from the data), the numbers inside the contacts are legible on them, and the shell, the
// names and the numbers outside the contacts are legible against the stage.
func TestDesktopECalcPinoutSkinsBrowser(t *testing.T) {
	f, _ := startPinouts(t)
	page := f.Page
	skins := []string{}
	for _, theme := range parseDesktopThemeRegistry(t) {
		if theme.ID == "fruity" {
			skins = append(skins, "fruity-light", "fruity-dark")
		} else {
			skins = append(skins, theme.ID)
		}
	}
	type measure struct {
		Bg    string
		Size  bool
		Fills string
		Shell float64
		Body  float64
		Names float64
		Inks  float64
	}
	const outlineMin, textMin, inkMin = 3.0, 4.5, 4.5
	for _, id := range []string{"fx_pin_usb_c", "fx_pin_atx24", "fx_pin_board38"} {
		f.open(id)
		fills := ""
		for _, skin := range skins {
			page.MustEval(`id=>fixtureTheme(id)`, skin)
			var m measure
			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(page.MustEval(pinoutContrastJS).Str()), &m); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			t.Logf("skin %-14s %-14s shell %.2f contact outline %.2f names %.2f ink %.2f (stage rgb %s)", skin, id, m.Shell, m.Body, m.Names, m.Inks, m.Bg)
			if !m.Size {
				t.Errorf("skin %s, %s: the drawing has no size", skin, id)
			}
			if m.Shell < outlineMin || m.Body < outlineMin || m.Names < textMin || m.Inks < inkMin {
				t.Errorf("skin %s, %s: the drawing is hard to read (shell %.2f, contact outline %.2f, names %.2f, ink on contact %.2f, stage rgb %s)", skin, id, m.Shell, m.Body, m.Names, m.Inks, m.Bg)
			}
			if fills == "" {
				fills = m.Fills
			} else if m.Fills != fills {
				t.Errorf("skin %s, %s draws the contacts in other colours than the first skin: %s vs %s", skin, id, m.Fills, fills)
			}
			if id == "fx_pin_usb_c" && (skin == "fruity-light" || skin == "cyberpunk" || skin == "minimal") {
				f.Shot("pinout-skin-" + skin)
			}
		}
		page.MustEval(`()=>fixtureTheme('standard')`)
	}
	// The contact colour is the hex of the data: the computed fill equals the hex of the catalog pin type.
	f.open("fx_pin_dsub")
	drawn := page.MustEval(`()=>{return JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('svg.ec-pin-art g.ec-pin')].map(g=>g.querySelector('.ec-pin-body').getAttribute('fill')));}`).Str()
	if !strings.Contains(drawn, "#") {
		t.Fatalf("the contacts carry their hex as an attribute: %s", drawn)
	}
	for _, pt := range f.Catalog.PinTypeStyles {
		if !strings.Contains(drawn, pt.Hex) && pt.ID != "nc" {
			t.Errorf("the pin type %s (%s) is not drawn by the Sub-D fixture: %s", pt.ID, pt.Hex, drawn)
		}
	}
}
```
